Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire des contrats de services

Le spécialiste mondial de la prévision des pièces de rechange sert de centre central entre les organismes de services locaux (OSL) d'ABB dans plusieurs pays et les usines d'alimentation fournissant des pièces de rechange UPS. Ce rôle combine la prévision stratégique de la demande et le soutien opérationnel pour la vente de pièces de rechange et la prestation de services. L'objectif principal est d'assurer la saisie exacte du signal de demande, la consolidation et la traduction en plans d'approvisionnement réalisables tout en appuyant la gestion des pièces de rechange de bout en bout afin d'atteindre la qualité du service de haut niveau, l'efficacité opérationnelle, la livraison à temps, la croissance des commandes et la satisfaction de la clientèle.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride #LI-hybrid

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Élaborer et tenir à jour des prévisions de la demande de pièces de rechange, regrouper les intrants des ASL et intégrer les données de base installées, les taux de défaillance, les contrats de service, les changements du cycle de vie des produits et les nouvelles introductions de produits. Les résultats de l'enquête sont les suivants: Collaborer avec les équipes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de l'ingénierie, de la gestion des produits, de la fabrication et des services afin d'assurer la disponibilité des pièces, de gérer les risques d'approvisionnement et d'appuyer les activités de planification des stocks, des délais et des délais de livraison. Surveiller le rendement des prévisions et de l'offre au moyen des ICR et des tableaux de bord, cerner les anomalies de la demande et prendre des mesures correctives pour améliorer l'exactitude des prévisions, les niveaux de service et la livraison à temps.
  • Favoriser l'amélioration continue des processus de planification, des outils de prévision, de la qualité des données du PGI, des plateformes de commerce électronique et des initiatives d'automatisation tout en assurant la conformité aux normes d'ESH et d'intégrité de l'ABB.

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Baccalauréat en chaîne d'approvisionnement, affaires, génie, ou un domaine connexe.
  • 5+ ans d'expérience dans la planification des pièces de rechange, la prévision de la demande, les opérations de service ou la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
  • L'expérience en électronique de puissance, en UPS, en systèmes d'alimentation critiques ou en équipement industriel est privilégiée.
  • Profiabilité avec les systèmes ERP (p. ex. SAP), les outils de prévision, les solutions Excel/BI et les plateformes de commerce électronique.
  • Fluent English; d'autres langues européennes sont un avantage.
  • Un état d'esprit analytique et fondé sur les données, capable de développer et d'améliorer les modèles de prévision.
  • Excellente gestion des intervenants et excellente communication interculturelle, avec la capacité de traduire des apports complexes en recommandations concrètes.
  • Connaissance approfondie des stratégies en matière de pièces de rechange, des opérations de service et de l'amélioration des processus, en mettant l'accent sur la disponibilité des services, la prestation des services, la normalisation et l'automatisation.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Program Director NewGen PA

__

Role overview:

Leads the Tier 2 Architecture end-to-end Business Solution Design and coordinates development and implementation at the multinational, regional, or global function level, using ABB and/or third-party resources. Leads project execution in accordance with company procedures, relevant cybersecurity regulations and standards, project objectives, applicable quality standards, safety requirements, and cost and scheduling targets. Applies project management processes as applicable.

Core responsibilities:

Project Leadership

  • Leads the team allocated to the project, defines the main guidelines, allocates project tasks, and motivates and monitors internal and/or external resources to accomplish all tasks and milestones.

  • Coaches, develops, and provides feedback to individuals allocated to managed projects. Provides input to the NewGen Resource Manager to support short-term and longer-term development planning for ABB employees.

Instructions and guidelines:

  • Ensures projects follow sound methodology and execution practices in accordance with standard ABB internal directives and procedures, as described in the NewGen PMO Handbook. The project is governed under the ABB Gate Model.

Budget, sales, and operations planning:

  • Keeps up to date and informed about any changes in strategy and is consulted regarding any activities or other projects that have, or might have, a major impact on the project.

  • Develops and gains approval for a business case defining the value proposition of the project.

Project execution and control:

  • Develops a project charter and a project plan (within MS Project) describing how the project will be executed, for communication to project team members and key stakeholders, approval, and as the basis for execution.

  • Organizes, monitors, and controls activities to ensure the effective achievement of planned stage gates and efficient utilization of available resources.

  • Monitors and controls project costs and financials. Identifies, contains, and reduces risks and ensures that all opportunities are captured and acted upon.

  • Formalizes acceptance of the project and concludes all project activities. Prepares handover documentation and training.

  • Manage consultancy partners and solution integrators

  • Plans and tracks all project activities, establishes scheduling risks and opportunities, and delivers projects on time according to commitments.

Stakeholder relations:

  • Serves as the key contact for project stakeholders and an escalation point for project issues.

  • Communicates appropriate information to stakeholders in a timely and effective manner to achieve the desired understanding and support.

  • Develops dedicated stakeholder management and change management plans and applies best practices in change management.

People leadership and development:

  • Develops and manages team members through formal and informal mentoring and coaching.

  • Ensures, in collaboration with the NewGen Resource Manager, appropriate qualification levels of the selected team members.

  • Leads project team members to achieve project requirements, deliver agreed deliverables, and meet the committed project result.

Document management:

  • In collaboration with the NewGen PMO, identifies and plans all document deliverables required by the contractual scope of work and incorporates this plan into the overall project plan/schedule.

  • Tracks document progress and follows up on overdue comments from the NewGen PMO and Gate Assessors.

Key requirements:

  • +15 years of experience in leading the execution of internal strategic business projects at multinational, regional, or global function level, using internal and/or third-party resources.

  • Proven project management practice and experience.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Proven ability to work in international teams.

  • Certification: PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, Agile/Scrum certification (e.g., CSM, SAFe), or ABB Program PM Certified according to 2YAD100055 IS Function Standard_IS Project Manager Certification.

We are open to applications from all qualified candidates. However, from a collaboration perspective, we would preferably consider candidates who are already based in Europe.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB , aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snella e più pulita, e ogni persona qui lo fa accadere. Sarete autorizzati a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che dirige il mondo. Questa posizione riferisce a:

Program Director NewGen PA

<

Indirizzo="text-align:inherit!important"> Conduce l'esecuzione del progetto in conformità con le procedure aziendali, le normative e gli standard relativi alla sicurezza informatica, gli obiettivi del progetto, gli standard di qualità applicabili, i requisiti di sicurezza e gli obiettivi di costo e pianificazione. Si applica ai processi di gestione del progetto come applicabile. Conduce il team assegnato al progetto, definisce le principali linee guida, assegna i compiti del progetto, e motiva e monitora le risorse interne e/o esterne per realizzare tutte le attività e le pietre miliari. Fornisce input al NewGen Resource Manager per sostenere la pianificazione di sviluppo a breve e a lungo termine per i dipendenti ABB. Assicura che i progetti seguano la metodologia e le pratiche di esecuzione sonore secondo le direttive e le procedure interne ABB standard, come descritto nel Manuale NewGen PMO. Il progetto è disciplinato dal modello della porta ABB. Sviluppa una carta di progetto e un piano di progetto (nel progetto MS) che descrive come il progetto verrà eseguito, per la comunicazione ai membri del team di progetto e agli stakeholder chiave, l'approvazione e come base per l'esecuzione. Identifica, contiene e riduce i rischi e assicura che tutte le opportunità vengano catturate e agite. Prepara la documentazione e la formazione di consegna. I progetti e le attività del progetto sono in grado di fornire ai membri della direzione e di fornire i progetti in tempo utile in base agli impegni. Conduce i membri del team di progetto a raggiungere i requisiti del progetto, fornire i risultati del progetto concordati e soddisfare il risultato del progetto impegnato. In collaborazione con il NewGen PMO, identifica e progetta tutti i risultati del documento richiesti dall'ambito contrattuale del lavoro e incorpora questo piano nel progetto globale/schedule. Tuttavia, da un punto di vista di collaborazione, consideriamo preferibilmente i candidati che hanno già sede in Europa. Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente prende tutti i tipi di menti: i curiosi, i coraggiosi e i creativi. Questo è il motivo per cui accogliamo le persone da tutti gli sfondi e le esperienze.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus rationnelle et plus propre. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Directeur de programme NewGen PA

Récapitulatif du rôle :

Maîtrise l'architecture de niveau 2 de bout en bout Solution opérationnelle Conception et coordination du développement et de la mise en oeuvre au niveau des fonctions multinationales, régionales ou mondiales, en utilisant les ressources ABB et/ou tierces parties. Dirige l'exécution du projet conformément aux procédures de l'entreprise, aux règlements et aux normes pertinents en matière de cybersécurité, aux objectifs du projet, aux normes de qualité applicables, aux exigences de sécurité et aux objectifs de coûts et de calendrier. Applique les processus de gestion de projet selon le cas.

Responsabilités de base :

Le leadership de projet

  • Dirige l'équipe affectée au projet, définit les principales lignes directrices, répartit les tâches du projet et motive et surveille les ressources internes et/ou externes pour accomplir toutes les tâches et étapes.

  • Coache, élabore et fournit des commentaires aux personnes affectées aux projets gérés. Fournir des commentaires au gestionnaire des ressources du nouveau-géne pour appuyer la planification du perfectionnement à court et à long terme des employés d'ABB.

Instructions et lignes directrices :

  • Veiller à ce que les projets respectent des méthodes et des pratiques d'exécution saines, conformément aux directives et procédures internes normalisées de l'ABB, telles qu'elles sont décrites dans le manuel de l'OMP NewGen. Le projet est régi par le modèle ABB Gate.

Planification des budgets, des ventes et des opérations :

  • Consiste à être à jour et informé de tout changement de stratégie et est consulté au sujet de toute activité ou autre projet ayant ou pouvant avoir un impact important sur le projet.

  • Développe et obtient l'approbation d'une analyse de rentabilisation définissant la proposition de valeur du projet.

Exécution et contrôle du projet :

  • < Élaborer une charte de projet et un plan de projet (dans le cadre du projet MS) décrivant comment le projet sera exécuté, pour la communication aux membres de l'équipe de projet et aux principaux intervenants, l'approbation et comme base d'exécution.

  • Organise, surveille et contrôle les activités afin d'assurer la réalisation efficace des grilles d'étape prévues et l'utilisation efficace des ressources disponibles.

  • Moniteurs et contrôle les coûts et les finances du projet. Indique, contient et réduit les risques et veille à ce que toutes les possibilités soient saisies et mises en oeuvre.

  • Formalise l'acceptation du projet et termine toutes les activités du projet. Préparer la documentation de transfert et la formation.

  • Gérer les partenaires de consultation et les intégrateurs de solutions

  • Planifier et suivre toutes les activités du projet, établir les risques et les possibilités et exécuter les projets dans les délais prévus.

    • Relations avec les intervenants :

    • Serve de contact clé pour les intervenants du projet et d'un point d'escalade pour les questions liées au projet.

    • Communique de l'information appropriée aux intervenants de façon opportune et efficace afin d'obtenir la compréhension et le soutien souhaités.

      • Le leadership et le perfectionnement des personnes :

    Gestion des documents:

    • En collaboration avec le BGP de NewGen, détermine et planifie tous les produits livrables exigés par la portée contractuelle du travail et incorpore ce plan dans le plan/l'échéancier global du projet.

    • Tracks documente les progrès accomplis et fait suite aux commentaires en retard du BGP de NewGen et des évaluateurs de portails.

    Prescriptions clés :

    • +15 années d'expérience dans la direction de projets opérationnels stratégiques internes au niveau des fonctions multinationales, régionales ou mondiales, à l'aide de ressources internes et/ou tierces parties.

    • Mise en pratique et expérience en gestion de projets.

    • Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

      Prêt à faire un impact?

      Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: Fulfillment Specialist (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Fulfillment Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities
Join ABB and become a vital part of our supply chain, ensuring the seamless flow of materials from our global suppliers to our production lines. In this critical role, you will be the central point of contact for purchasing and fulfillment, where your planning and problem-solving skills will directly impact our ability to deliver high-quality products to our customers on time, every time.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly responsible for

  • End-to-End Order Management: Manage the entire purchasing lifecycle within SAP, from creating and releasing purchase orders to actively monitoring and expediting them to align with production schedules and customer delivery deadlines.

  • Supplier Performance & Partnership: Drive supplier excellence by monitoring key performance indicators such as on-time delivery, quality, and lead times. You will conduct performance reviews and proactively resolve issues to strengthen our supply chain partnerships.

  • Logistics Coordination & Problem Solving: Oversee the inbound logistics process, including freight and customs clearance. You will be the go-to expert for handling urgent delivery situations and managing non-conformance reports to ensure operational continuity.

  • Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities to improve our fulfillment process by analyzing order backlogs, identifying root causes for delays, and implementing effective recovery plans. You will monitor and ensure the integrity of data exchanged through supplier EDI systems.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A degree or diploma in a technical field, Process Management, or Supply Chain Management.

  • Proven experience in a similar role within a manufacturing or industrial environment.

  • Strong, hands-on knowledge of SAP is essential for this role.

  • Excellent communication skills with fluency in both English and Italian.

  • A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic setting.

  • Experience with order handling, inventory management, and data analysis would be a significant advantage.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is led by Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Fulfillment Lead

  • End-to-End Order Management: Verwalten Sie den gesamten Einkaufslebenszyklus innerhalb von SAP, von der Erstellung und Freigabe von Bestellungen bis hin zur aktiven Überwachung und Beschleunigung, um sie an die Produktionspläne und Lieferfristen der Kunden anzupassen.

  • Logistikkoordination & Problemlösung: Beaufsichtigen Sie den Inbound-Logistikprozess, einschließlich der Fracht- und Zollabfertigung. Sie sind der Ansprechpartner für dringende Liefersituationen und die Verwaltung von Nichtkonformitätsberichten, um die operative Kontinuität zu gewährleisten.

  • Datenanalyse & Prozessverbesserung: Erkennen Sie proaktiv Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung unseres Fulfillment-Prozesses, indem Sie Auftragsrückstände analysieren, Ursachen für Verzögerungen identifizieren und effektive Wiederherstellungspläne implementieren.   • Ein Abschluss oder Diplom in einem technischen Bereich, Prozessmanagement oder Supply Chain Management.

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einer Fertigungs- oder Industrieumgebung.

  • Starke, praktische Kenntnisse von SAP sind für diese Rolle unerlässlich.

  • Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit fließender Englisch- und Italienischkenntnissen.

  • Eine proaktive und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu verwalten.

Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Acquisition Partner bei ABB Schweiz, geleitet.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Project Operations Manager

__

Take your next career step at ABB with a team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.

In this role, you will lead a team of eight Project Managers and oversee a diverse portfolio of customer projects within ABB's Motion Traction division in Turgi, Switzerland. You will drive project execution and operational excellence by setting clear priorities, providing guidance and mentorship, fostering collaboration, and ensuring the successful delivery of projects in line with quality, schedule, and financial objectives.

The work model is hybrid.

• Your responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop the Project Management team, setting performance expectations, coaching and mentoring team members, fostering engagement, and promoting a culture aligned with ABB's values and people-focused strategies.

  • Ensure successful delivery of customer projects, driving on-time, high-quality, and cost-effective execution while supporting bid activities, managing risks, and maintaining strong customer focus and stakeholder collaboration.

  • Drive project management excellence and continuous improvement, establishing effective methodologies, processes, governance frameworks, and best practices to strengthen project execution capabilities across the organization.

  • Monitor business performance and resource effectiveness, overseeing KPIs, portfolio performance, operational improvements, and cross-functional collaboration with supply chain and other stakeholders to achieve contractual, quality, and financial objectives.

• Your profile:

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • 5-10 years of experience managing complex projects, including scope, budget, schedule, and supplier/subcontractor performance.

  • Previous experience leading a team of Project Managers is highly desirable.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

  • Fluency in German and English is required; additional language skills are considered an asset.

More about us

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Real Estate Manager

Take your next career step at ABB with a team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.

At ABB, we are committed to driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions. Together, we create an environment where individual differences are valued and celebrated.

Do you have extensive experience in Corporate Real Estate and Facility Management within Switzerland?? Would you like to take responsibility for ABB's Facility Management operations across Switzerland and lead a major FM transformation program? Then join our team in Baden as Lead Facility Management Switzerland.

In this key leadership role, you will be responsible for ABB's Facility Management operations across Switzerland, overseeing a nationwide portfolio of approximately 240,000 sqm of office, production, R&D and logistics space across multiple locations. You will oversee the delivery of integrated FM services through external partners, drive operational excellence and cost optimization, and play a key role in shaping the future FM operating model for ABB Switzerland.

Your • Responsibilities

  • Lead Facility Management service delivery across ABB's Swiss portfolio, acting as the primary interface with the integrated FM provider and ensuring contractual compliance, governance, KPI achievement, and service excellence.

  • Drive the completion of ABB's national FM transformation, including finalization of the FM tender, transition planning, and successful mobilization of the selected FM provider across all Swiss locations.

  • Optimize operational performance, compliance and cost efficiency, ensuring adherence to regulatory, HSE and ABB standards while delivering continuous improvements in service quality, sustainability and user experience.

In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snello e più pulito.E ogni persona qui fa che accada. You.ll essere autorizzato a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che gestisce il mondo.

Questa posizione riporta a: Real Estate Manager

E' un'idea divertente.

Fate il vostro prossimo passo di carriera in ABB con un team che sta stimolando la trasformazione della società e dell'industria per raggiungere un futuro più produttivo e sostenibile.

In ABB ci impegniamo a guidare la diversità e l'inclusione in tutte le dimensioni. Insieme creiamo un ambiente dove le differenze individuali vengono valutate e celebrate.

Hai una vasta esperienza nel settore del Corporate Real Estate and Facility Management in Svizzera? Vuoi assumerti la responsabilità delle operazioni di ABB Facility Management in Svizzera e condurre un importante programma di trasformazione FM? Allora unisciti al nostro team di Baden come Lead Facility Management Svizzera.

In questo ruolo di leadership, sarete responsabili delle operazioni di ABB in Svizzera, supervisionando un portafoglio nazionale di circa 240.000 mq di uffici, produzione, R&D e logistica in più sedi. Soprintenderete alla fornitura di servizi integrati FM attraverso partner esterni, guidando l'eccellenza operativa e l'ottimizzazione dei costi e svolgendo un ruolo chiave nella definizione del futuro modello operativo FM per ABB Svizzera.

Le vostre responsabilità

- Servizio di gestione delle strutture di Lead in tutto il portafoglio svizzero di ABB, che funge da interfaccia primaria con il provider integrato FM e garantisce la conformità contrattuale, la governance, il raggiungimento di KPI ed eccellenza dei servizi.

- Guidare il completamento della trasformazione nazionale FM di ABB, tra cui la finalizzazione del bando di gara FM, pianificazione della transizione, e la mobilitazione di successo del nuovo partner FM in tutte le sedi svizzere.

- Ottimizzare le prestazioni operative, la conformità e l'efficienza dei costi, garantendo il rispetto degli standard normativi, HSE e ABB, garantendo nel contempo continui miglioramenti in termini di qualità del servizio, sostenibilità ed esperienza degli utenti.

- Sostenere gli obiettivi strategici in materia di immobili e strutture, sfruttando intuizioni basate sui dati, collaborazione con gli stakeholder e leadership dei progetti per migliorare le prestazioni del portafoglio e fornire investimenti negli impianti.

Il tuo background

- Laurea magistrale in Gestione delle strutture, Immobiliare, Ingegneria, Amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato.

- Circa 10 anni di esperienza nel settore immobiliare e/o Corporate Facility Management all'interno della Svizzera, preferibilmente all'interno di una grande organizzazione multisito.

- Esperienza di Proven che gestisce contratti FM esternalizzati, fornitori di servizi esterni e modelli integrati di fornitura di servizi FM.

- Esperienza leader FM trasformazione, outsourcing, mobilitazione, o progetti di transizione, con forti competenze di gestione del progetto e la capacità di guidare complesse iniziative cross-funzionali.

- Una forte comprensione della gestione operativa delle strutture, gestione dei contratti, monitoraggio delle prestazioni, budgeting, previsione e ottimizzazione dei costi.

- Eccellente capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di influenzare e collaborare efficacemente a tutti i livelli organizzativi; mentalità proattiva, orientata al cliente e orientata alla soluzione.

- E' necessaria una fluenza in tedesco e inglese; l'esperienza che guida le iniziative di trasformazione digitale in Facility Management, inclusi gli edifici intelligenti, la manutenzione predittiva, l'automazione del flusso di lavoro e l'analisi avanzata, è un forte vantaggio.

Perché unirsi a noi?

Questa è un'occasione unica per dare forma al futuro di Facility Management presso ABB Svizzera. Oltre a gestire un importante portafoglio immobiliare, si condurrà il passaggio a un nuovo modello integrato di consegna FM e stabilire le basi per l'eccellenza operativa a lungo termine in tutto il paese.

Più su di noi

La nostra missione in Real Estate (RE) è quella di consentire alle aziende ABB di svolgere al meglio il proprio lavoro attraverso una gestione immobiliare globale che copra il ciclo di vita completo end-to-end dalla selezione del sito, la gestione e la manutenzione fino alla terminazione del sito. Abbiamo una passione per l'eccellenza operativa e facciamo ogni sforzo per creare valore per le aziende ABB. I nostri sforzi crescono da un impegno per fornire ambienti di lavoro sani e coinvolgenti, migliorare l'efficienza energetica e la sostenibilità e ottimizzare l'efficienza spaziale per tutti i nostri edifici in più di 100 paesi in tutto il mondo.

Noi apprezziamo le persone provenienti da contesti diversi.

Potrebbe essere la tua storia?

Diese Position berichtet an: Immobilienmanager

Machen Sie Ihren nächsten Karriereschritt bei ABB mit einem Team, das die Transformation von Gesellschaft und Industrie zu einer produktiveren, nachhaltigeren Zukunft antreibt.

Bei ABB setzen wir uns für Vielfalt und Inklusion in allen Dimensionen ein. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem individuelle Unterschiede geschätzt und gefeiert werden.

Sie haben umfangreiche Erfahrung im Corporate Real Estate and Facility Management innerhalb der Schweiz? Sie möchten die Verantwortung für die Facility Management-Aktivitäten der ABB in der ganzen Schweiz übernehmen und ein großes FM-Transformationsprogramm leiten? Dann schließen Sie sich unserem Team in Baden als Lead Facility Management Schweiz an.

In dieser zentralen Führungsrolle übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Facility Management-Aktivitäten der ABB in der ganzen Schweiz, die ein bundesweites Portfolio von rund 240.000 qm Büro-, Produktions-, FuE- und Logistikflächen an mehreren Standorten beaufsichtigen. Sie überwachen die Lieferung integrierter FM-Dienste über externe Partner, treiben operative Exzellenz und Kostenoptimierung voran und spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung des zukünftigen FM-Betriebsmodells für ABB Schweiz.

• Verantwortung

- Lead Facility Management Service-Lieferung über das Schweizer Portfolio von ABB, die als primäre Schnittstelle mit dem integrierten FM-Anbieter und die Gewährleistung der vertraglichen Compliance, Governance, KPI-Erfolg und Service-Excellence.

- Antrieb für die Fertigstellung der nationalen FM-Transformation von ABB, einschließlich der Fertigstellung der FM-Ausschreibung, der Übergangsplanung und der erfolgreichen Mobilisierung des neuen FM-Partners an allen Schweizer Standorten.

- Optimieren Sie die operative Leistung, Compliance und Kosteneffizienz, um die Einhaltung der regulatorischen, HSE- und ABB-Standards zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig kontinuierliche Verbesserungen in der Servicequalität, Nachhaltigkeit und Benutzererfahrung zu erzielen.

- Unterstützung strategischer Immobilien- und Anlagenziele, Nutzung datengesteuerter Erkenntnisse, Zusammenarbeit der Stakeholder und Projektführung zur Verbesserung der Portfolioleistung und Bereitstellung von Anlageninvestitionen.

Ihr Hintergrund

- Bachelor oder Master in Facility Management, Real Estate, Engineering, Business Administration oder einem verwandten Bereich.

- Etwa 10 Jahre Erfahrung in Corporate Real Estate und/oder Corporate Facility Management innerhalb der Schweiz, vorzugsweise innerhalb einer großen Multi-Site-Organisation.

- Bewährte Erfahrung mit Outsourced FM Verträge, externe Dienstleister und integrierte FM Service Delivery Modelle.

- Erfahrung führende FM Transformation, Outsourcing, Mobilisierung oder Übergangsprojekte, mit starken Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe funktionsübergreifende Initiativen zu treiben.

- Ein starkes Verständnis des Betriebs Facility Management, Vertragsmanagement, Leistungsüberwachung, Budgetierung, Prognose und Kostenoptimierung.

- Ausgezeichnete Stakeholder-Management- und Kommunikationskompetenzen, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv auf allen Organisationsebenen zu beeinflussen und zusammenzuarbeiten; proaktive, kundenorientierte und lösungsorientierte Denkweise.

- Es ist eine fließende deutsche und englische Sprache erforderlich; die Erfahrung, die Initiativen zur digitalen Transformation im Facility Management vorantreibt, einschließlich KI, Smart Buildings, Predictive Maintenance, Workflow Automation und Advanced Analytics, ist ein starker Vorteil.

Warum uns begleiten?

Dies ist eine einzigartige Chance, die Zukunft des Facility Managements bei ABB Schweiz zu gestalten. Neben der Verwaltung eines bedeutenden Immobilienportfolios führen Sie den Übergang zu einem neuen integrierten FM-Liefermodell und schaffen die Grundlage für langfristige operative Exzellenz im ganzen Land.

Mehr über uns

Unsere Mission in Real Estate (RE) ist es, ABB-Unternehmen durch ein globales Immobilienmanagement, das den gesamten Lebenszyklus von der Standortauswahl, dem Management und der Wartung bis zur Beendigung des Betriebs abdeckt, zu ermöglichen, ihre besten Leistungen zu erbringen. Wir haben eine Leidenschaft für operative Exzellenz und bemühen uns, Wert für ABB-Unternehmen zu schaffen. Unsere Bemühungen wachsen aus dem Engagement heraus, gesunde und engagierte Arbeitsumgebungen bereitzustellen, Energieeffizienz und Nachhaltigkeit zu verbessern und die Raumeffizienz für alle unsere Gebäude in mehr als 100 Ländern der Welt zu optimieren.

Bewerben Sie sich heute oder besuchen Sie www.abb.com, um mehr über uns zu erfahren und über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren. #MyABBStory

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung (Dokumente in englischer Sprache werden geschätzt).

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus maigres et plus propres, et chaque personne ici fait cela. Vous, serez habilité à diriger, soutenu pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble.

Ce poste relève de : Gestionnaire immobilier

__

Prenez votre prochaine étape de carrière à ABB avec une équipe qui est en train d'activer la transformation de la société et de l'industrie pour atteindre un avenir plus productif et durable.

Chez ABB, nous nous engageons à stimuler la diversité et l'inclusion dans toutes les dimensions. Ensemble, nous créons un environnement où les différences individuelles sont appréciées et célébrées.

Vous avez une vaste expérience en gestion immobilière et de la gestion des installations en Suisse? Vous voulez prendre en charge les opérations de gestion des installations d'ABB dans toute la Suisse et diriger un programme de transformation FM majeur? Ensuite, rejoignez notre équipe à Baden comme responsable de la gestion des installations en Suisse.

Dans ce rôle de leader, vous serez responsable des opérations de gestion des installations d'ABB dans toute la Suisse, superviserez un portefeuille national d'environ 240 000 m2 d'espaces de bureau, de production, de R & D et de logistique sur plusieurs sites. Vous superviserez la prestation de services FM intégrés par l'intermédiaire de partenaires externes, stimulerez l'excellence opérationnelle et l'optimisation des coûts, et jouerez un rôle clé dans la formation du futur modèle opérationnel FM d'ABB Suisse.

Vos responsabilités

- Prestation de services de gestion de l'installation de pointe dans l'ensemble du portefeuille suisse d'ABB, agissant comme interface principale avec le fournisseur de FM intégré et assurant la conformité contractuelle, la gouvernance, la réalisation de l'ICK et l'excellence des services.

- Conduire l'achèvement de la transformation nationale de la FM d'ABB, y compris la finalisation de l'appel d'offres FM, la planification de la transition et la mobilisation réussie du nouveau partenaire FM dans tous les sites suisses.

- Optimiser la performance opérationnelle, la conformité et l'efficacité économique, en veillant au respect des normes réglementaires, HSE et ABB tout en améliorant continuellement la qualité du service, la durabilité et l'expérience des utilisateurs.

- Appuyer les objectifs stratégiques en matière d'immobilier et d'installations, en tirant parti des données recueillies, en collaborant avec les intervenants et en dirigeant des projets pour améliorer le rendement du portefeuille et réaliser des investissements dans les installations.

Vos antécédents

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en gestion d'installations, immobilier, génie, administration des affaires ou un domaine connexe.

- Environ 10 ans d'expérience en gestion immobilière et/ou en gestion d'entreprise en Suisse, de préférence au sein d'une grande organisation multi-site.

- Provenez de l'expérience en gérant les contrats de FM sous-traités, les fournisseurs de services externes et les modèles intégrés de prestation de services de FM.

- Expérience de projets de transformation, d'externalisation, de mobilisation ou de transition de la gestion de projet, avec de solides compétences en gestion de projet et la capacité de mener des initiatives interfonctionnelles complexes.

- Une bonne compréhension de la gestion opérationnelle des installations, de la gestion des contrats, du suivi des performances, de la budgétisation, des prévisions et de l'optimisation des coûts.

- Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication, avec la capacité d'influencer et de collaborer efficacement à tous les niveaux organisationnels; attitude proactive, axée sur le client et orientée vers la solution.

- La maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais est nécessaire; l'expérience qui conduit les initiatives de transformation numérique dans la gestion des installations, y compris l'IA, les bâtiments intelligents, la maintenance prédictive, l'automatisation des workflows et l'analyse avancée, est un avantage important.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre?

C'est une occasion unique de façonner l'avenir de Facility Management chez ABB Suisse. Au-delà de la gestion d'un important portefeuille immobilier, vous dirigerez la transition vers un nouveau modèle de livraison FM intégré et établirez les bases d'une excellence opérationnelle à long terme dans tout le pays.

Plus sur nous

Notre mission en immobilier (RE) est de permettre aux entreprises ABB de se comporter au mieux grâce à une gestion immobilière globale qui couvre le cycle de vie complet de bout en bout, de la sélection, de la gestion et de la maintenance du site à la terminaison du site. Nous sommes passionnés par l'excellence opérationnelle et faisons tout notre possible pour créer de la valeur pour les entreprises ABB.

Nous apprécions les gens de différents horizons.

Ça pourrait être votre histoire?

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Manufacturing Unit Manager

__

We're seeking a strategic Operations Leader to manage cross-functional coordination and operational excellence across our Manufacturing Unit. You'll develop Integrated Production Unit leaders, facilitate collaboration between Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance, and HR functions, and lead transformation initiatives that remove barriers to execution. Your main focus will be on structuring and executing ramp-up plan (3X actual volume), embracing the operations scope end-to-end (from supply readiness to material availability and production readiness).

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid.

This role is contributing to the Smart Power division in Quartino.

Your main responsibilities will be:

· Elevate Leadership & Support Alignment: Coach and develop IPU Leaders, encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across the organization, improve problem-solving and team engagement practices, and guide the maturity and evolution of the IPU model while ensuring seamless alignment of priorities and action plans

· Lead Transformation & Build for the Future: Coordinate strategic manufacturing projects and transformation initiatives, with focus on volume ramp-up on supply chain, production workers, office workers and test infrastructure, contributing to the long-term development of the operations

· Bridge Functions & Support Operational Excellence: Serve as the primary facilitator across Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance, Agile units (R&D/PM), and HR, standardizing and deploying best practices while ensuring alignment on priorities, resources, and execution plans; resolve cross-functional barriers and escalations, and promote a culture of transparency, accountability, and continuous learning

· Measure Success Through Tangible Impact: Remove cross-functional barriers to execution, improve value stream efficiency and operational stability, increase collaboration and alignment across IPUs and support functions, and build greater maturity and autonomy among IPU Leaders

What we are looking for:

· Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering; +10 years of progressive experience as Operations Manager (or similar role e.g. Planning & fulfillment manager)

· Demonstrated ability to structure & implement production ramp up in less than 12 months to triple production volumes, ensuring strong governance across complex organizations and cross-functional teams (planning, procurement, quality, production, engineering)

· Deep knowledge (360° view) of operations processes (from engineering to material availability, to capacity planning & order execution), with a commitment to delivering operational excellence at scale

· Skilled in leading cross-functional projects, overseeing quality assurance initiatives, and maintaining a clear focus on customer satisfaction

· Deep understanding of supply chain and bottleneck to ramp-up production, as well as proven experience to mitigate risks (eg- double sourcing, strategic agreement, etc.)

· Solid analytical skills with the ability to translate data and reporting insights into actionable improvements that enhance performance and business outcomes

· Fluent in Italian (written and spoken); proficiency in English is an advantage

• What we offer:

· Employee Share Plan (ESAP)

· Remote work & flexible work schedules

· Attractive Parental Leave

__

Nous cherchons un chef d'exploitation stratégique pour gérer la coordination interfonctionnelle et l'excellence opérationnelle dans notre unité de fabrication. Vous développerez des chefs d'unité de production intégrée, faciliterez la collaboration entre les fonctions de production, qualité, chaîne d'approvisionnement, ingénierie, entretien et RH, et dirigerez des initiatives de transformation qui éliminent les obstacles à l'exécution.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-Hybrid.

Ce rôle contribue à la division Smart Power de Quarino.

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

· Élever le leadership et l'alignement du soutien : Coordonner et développer les dirigeants de l'UIP, encourager la collaboration et le partage des connaissances dans l'ensemble de l'organisation, améliorer les pratiques de résolution de problèmes et d'engagement des équipes, et guider la maturité et l'évolution du modèle de l'UIP tout en assurant une alignement sans faille des priorités et des plans d'action

· Lead Transformation & Build for the Future : Coordonner les projets stratégiques de fabrication et les initiatives de transformation, en mettant l'accent sur l'augmentation du volume de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les travailleurs de la production, les employés de bureau et les infrastructures d'essai, contribuant au développement à long terme des opérations

· Fonctions et soutien des ponts Excellence opérationnelle : servir de facilitateur principal dans les domaines de la production, de la qualité, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, du génie, de la maintenance, des unités agiles (R-D/PM) et des RH, normaliser et déployer les pratiques exemplaires tout en assurant l'harmonisation des priorités, des ressources et des plans d'exécution; résoudre les obstacles et les escalades interfonctionnels et promouvoir une culture de transparence, de responsabilisation et d'apprentissage continu

· Mesurer le succès par un impact tangible : supprimer les obstacles interfonctionnels à l'exécution, améliorer l'efficacité du flux de valeur et la stabilité opérationnelle, accroître la collaboration et l'alignement entre les UIP et les fonctions de soutien, et renforcer la maturité et l'autonomie des dirigeants de l'UIP

Ce que nous cherchons :

· Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie; +10 ans d'expérience progressive en tant que gestionnaire des opérations (ou rôle similaire, p. ex. gestionnaire de la planification et de l'exécution)

· Capacité démontrée de structurer et de mettre en oeuvre la production en un minimum de 12 mois pour tripler les volumes de production, assurant une gouvernance solide entre les organisations complexes et les équipes interfonctionnelles (planification, achats, qualité, production, ingénierie)

· Connaissance approfondie (360° vue) des processus opérationnels (de l'ingénierie à la disponibilité matérielle, à la planification des capacités et à l'exécution des commandes), avec un engagement à fournir l'excellence opérationnelle à l'échelle

· Compétence dans la conduite de projets interfonctionnels, la supervision des initiatives d'assurance de la qualité et le maintien d'un accent clair sur la satisfaction de la clientèle

· Une compréhension approfondie de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et du goulot d'étranglement pour accélérer la production, ainsi que l'expérience éprouvée pour atténuer les risques (par exemple, double approvisionnement, accord stratégique, etc.)

· Des compétences analytiques solides et la capacité de traduire les données et les données de rapport en améliorations pratiques qui améliorent le rendement et les résultats opérationnels

· La maîtrise de l'italien (écrite et parlée) est un avantage

· Régime d'actionnariat des employés (PAES)

· Travail à distance et horaires de travail flexibles

· Congé parental attrayant

En savoir plus sur nous : Chez ABB Smart Power, nous savons que les solutions prennent passion pour réussir et qu'il faut une véritable innovation pour une technologie pour s'intégrer dans leur monde et résoudre leurs problèmes.

Cela ne sera possible que si nous sommes passionnés et inclusifs. L'un ne peut pas travailler sans l'autre. Nos clients ont besoin que nous nous réunissions tous, avec une passion pour faire de grandes choses.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:
As an Order Management Specialist, you serve as the primary point of contact for customers and business partners regarding UPS Systems within the Electrification/ Power Protection business area, based in Baden, Switzerland.

Reporting to the Head of Project management & Engineering, you play a key role in supporting the sales-& project management team by leveraging your customer service & project execution expertise to manage and respond to customer inquiries and project needs efficiently and professionally.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Processes orders by coordinating with Sales, Project and other internal teams to ensure that customers receive accurate and timely delivery of products
  • Organize project material logistics with factory, suppliers and customers
  • Monitor order production status, delivery schedules, and proactively manage delays or escalations to maintain customer satisfaction
  • Handle invoicing and customer account setup in accordance with internal guidelines and project team input
  • Supports the sales/ project team in execution phase by resolving customer issues and ensuring effective and efficient customer and internal stakeholders communication


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Completed commercial apprenticeship; further education at higher vocational level (HF) is an advantage
  • Several years of professional experience in order processing or a similar role
  • Agile and proactive mindset with a proven ability to take ownership of customer issues
  • Solid knowledge and experience in customer service
  • Confident user of SAP
  • Experience in EU-Export Process is an advantage
  • Strong team player with a solution-oriented and independent working style, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Fluent in German and French; Italian is a plus and English is welcome


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers,
low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment is led by Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Fluent in Deutsch und Französisch; Italienisch ist ein Plus und Englisch ist willkommen

Gestionnaire des opérations de projet

En tant que spécialiste de la gestion des commandes, vous êtes le principal point de contact pour les clients et les partenaires commerciaux concernant UPS Systems dans le secteur d'activité Electrification/Protection de l'alimentation, basé à Baden, en Suisse.

  • Un état d'esprit agile et proactif avec une capacité éprouvée de prendre en charge les problèmes des clients
  • Solide connaissances et expérience en matière de service à la clientèle

Plus sur nous

ABB Smart Power fournit des solutions de distribution d'énergie pour les centres de données, les usines industrielles et manufacturières, les infrastructures essentielles et les bâtiments commerciaux. jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Maintenance Team Leader

__

At ABB, we value individual differences, both as individuals and as a team.

ABB Switzerland Ltd., CMC Low Voltage Products, with around 270 employees, is a leading developer, manufacturer, and international supplier of low-voltage protection devices and the CMS current monitoring system. A customer-focused mindset, short decision-making paths, and a high degree of personal responsibility are key to strengthening our market position.

To strengthen our motivated team in Schaffhausen, we are looking for an engaged Service Technician to join us as soon as possible. Do you enjoy solving technical problems and helping to ensure smooth operations in a stable, growing, and modern manufacturing environment?


We look forward to receiving your application.


Your role and responsibilities


• Troubleshoot and resolve issues on highly automated production equipment (mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic)

• Perform preventive maintenance and servicing of production equipment

• Collaborate closely with manufacturing teams, Production Engineering, and external service providers to ensure smooth production operations

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the production environment, including Lean Management activities


• Qualifications for the role


• Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician, Mechatronics Technician, Mechanical Technician, Production Technician, Electrician, or in a comparable technical field

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in industrial automation, ideally within a manufacturing environment

• Experience troubleshooting and repairing complex production and assembly systems (mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic)

• NIV13 or NIV15 electrical installation certification is an advantage, or willingness to obtain it with ABB support

• Strong teamwork and communication skills, combined with a proactive and independent working style

• Basic knowledge of MS Office and SAP, as well as excellent German language skills (written and spoken); English language skills are an advantage

• Willingness to work in a three-shift operation, including on-call duty after the onboarding period


Benefits


• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

• Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)

• Training, development, and career growth opportunities

• Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)

• REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco

• 27 to 30 days of annual leave, plus paid company holidays between Christmas and New Year


More about us


Our Schaffhausen site has been growing steadily for many years.

Our diverse production environment offers exciting and varied areas of responsibility, ranging from proven, long-established technologies to state-of-the-art system solutions. Our machine park is continuously expanding with new equipment that is aligned with industry benchmarks.

ABB Smart Buildings digitizes commercial, industrial, and residential buildings to deliver the highest levels of comfort, efficiency, safety, and security. Through safe, intelligent, and sustainable electrification solutions, services, and products, we are improving quality of life in the buildings of the future.


The recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

In ABB, apprezziamo le differenze individuali, sia come individui che come team.

ABB Switzerland Ltd., CMC Low Voltage Products, con circa 270 dipendenti, è uno sviluppatore, produttore e fornitore internazionale leader di dispositivi di protezione a bassa tensione e il sistema di monitoraggio corrente CMS. Una mentalità orientata al cliente, brevi percorsi decisionali e un alto grado di responsabilità personale sono fondamentali per rafforzare la nostra posizione sul mercato.

Per rafforzare il nostro team motivato a Schaffhausen, stiamo cercando un Service TechNICan impegnato a unirsi a noi il prima possibile. Ti piace risolvere problemi tecnici e contribuire a garantire operazioni fluide in un ambiente di produzione stabile, in crescita e moderno?

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

• Risolvere e risolvere problemi sulle apparecchiature di produzione altamente automatizzate (meccaniche, elettriche e pneumatiche)

• Eseguire la manutenzione preventiva e la manutenzione delle attrezzature di produzione

• Collaborare strettamente con i team di produzione, l'ingegneria di produzione e i fornitori di servizi esterni per garantire operazioni di produzione fluide

• Contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo nell'ambiente produttivo, comprese le attività di Lean Management

• Qualificazioni per il ruolo

• Formazione professionale completa come automazione TechNICan, Mechatronica TechNICan, Meccanica TechNICan, Produzione TechNICan, Elettrica, o in un campo tecnico comparabile

• Minimo 10 anni di esperienza nell'automazione industriale, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente di produzione

• Sperimenta la risoluzione dei problemi e ripara sistemi complessi di produzione e assemblaggio (meccanici, elettrici e pneumatici)

• La certificazione NIV13 o NIV15 è un vantaggio, o la volontà di ottenerlo con il supporto ABB

• Forte lavoro di squadra e capacità comunicative, combinato con uno stile di lavoro proattivo e indipendente

• Conoscenze di base dell'ufficio MS e del SAP, nonché eccellenti competenze linguistiche tedesche (scritte e parlate); competenze linguistiche inglesi sono un vantaggio

• Disponibilità a lavorare in un'operazione a tre turni, compreso il servizio di guardia dopo il periodo di bordo

Prestazioni

• Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti una gamma di vantaggi interessanti, tra cui:

• Pacchetto di compensazione attraente compreso bonus, 13 ° mese di stipendio, e Dipendente Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)

• opportunità di formazione, sviluppo e crescita della carriera

• Contributi per l'iscrizione in palestra e servizi medici (IFA)

• Buoni REKA e sconti tramite Swibeco

• 27-30 giorni di ferie annuali, più ferie aziendali retribuite tra Natale e Capodanno

Più su di noi

Il nostro sito di Schaffhausen è in costante crescita da molti anni.

Il nostro ambiente produttivo offre aree di responsabilità emozionanti e variegate, che vanno dalle tecnologie collaudate e consolidate alle soluzioni di sistema all'avanguardia. Il nostro parco macchine si sta espandendo continuamente con nuove attrezzature allineate ai benchmark del settore.

ABB Smart Buildings digitalizza edifici commerciali, industriali e residenziali per offrire i più alti livelli di comfort, efficienza, sicurezza e sicurezza. Attraverso soluzioni di elettrificazione, servizi e prodotti sicuri, intelligenti e sostenibili, stiamo migliorando la qualità della vita negli edifici del futuro.

Diese Position berichtet an: Wartung Team Leader

Bei ABB schätzen wir individuelle Unterschiede, sowohl als Individuen als auch als Team.

ABB Switzerland Ltd., CMC Low Voltage Products, mit rund 270 Mitarbeitern, ist ein führender Entwickler, Hersteller und internationaler Anbieter von Niederspannungsschutzgeräten und dem aktuellen CMS-Monitoring-System. Kundenorientiertes Denken, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein hohes Maß an persönlicher Verantwortung sind der Schlüssel zur Stärkung unserer Marktposition.

Um unser motiviertes Team in Schaffhausen zu stärken, suchen wir einen engagierten Servicetechniker, der sich so schnell wie möglich mit uns verbindet. Sie lösen gerne technische Probleme und helfen Ihnen, einen reibungslosen Betrieb in einem stabilen, wachsenden und modernen Fertigungsumfeld zu gewährleisten?

• Problembehandlung und Lösung von Problemen mit hochautomatisierten Produktionsanlagen (mechanische, elektrische und pneumatische)

• Präventive Wartung und Wartung von Produktionsanlagen durchführen

• Eng mit Fertigungsteams, Produktionstechnik und externen Dienstleistern zusammenarbeiten, um einen reibungslosen Produktionsablauf zu gewährleisten

• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen im Produktionsumfeld, einschließlich Lean Management-Aktivitäten

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Automationstechniker, Mechatroniker, Mechaniker, Produktionstechniker, Elektriker oder in einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich

• Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der industriellen Automatisierung, idealerweise in einem Fertigungsumfeld

• Erleben Sie die Fehlersuche und Reparatur komplexer Produktions- und Montagesysteme (mechanische, elektrische und pneumatische)

• Grundkenntnisse in MS Office und SAP sowie hervorragende Deutschkenntnisse (geschrieben und gesprochen); Englischkenntnisse sind ein Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in einem Dreischichtbetrieb, einschließlich Bereitschaftsdienst nach der Anbordzeit

• Attraktive Vergütungspakete mit Bonus, Gehalt für 13 Monate und Erwerbsprogramm für Employee Share (ESAP)

• Ausbildung, Entwicklung und Karrierechancen

• Beiträge zu Mitgliedschaften im Fitnessstudio und medizinischen Dienstleistungen (IFA)

• REKA Gutscheine und Rabatte über Swibeco

• 27 bis 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, plus bezahlte Firmenferien zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr

Seit vielen Jahren wächst unser Standort in Schaffhausen stetig.

Unser vielfältiges Produktionsumfeld bietet spannende und vielfältige Verantwortungsbereiche, von bewährten, bewährten Technologien bis hin zu hochmodernen Systemlösungen. Unser Maschinenpark baut kontinuierlich mit neuen Anlagen aus, die auf Branchen-Benchmarks abgestimmt sind.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Team Lead Administrative Services & Site Communications

__

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain valuable hands-on experience through a one-year placement starting on August 1, 2027. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing your personal and professional development opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

Administrative Services & Communication MOHP – ABB, Untersiggenthal

The position is based in Untersiggenthal, near Baden.

Your main responsibility will be to support employees from various departments in ensuring the smooth running of their daily work, as well as managing projects responsibly.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Onboarding and offboarding of new employees; Procurement of work materials (IT, hardware, software, office equipment, etc.).

  • Technical support for all IT related questions; Invoice processing using SAP based tools.

  • Event planning for employees and important (including international) customers; Management of promotional items in collaboration with our advertising agency.

  • Collaboration on improving internal workflows; Internal communication on current topics using various tools.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Student from a WMS or HMS

  • Knowledge of Office 365, especially PowerPoint and SharePoint

  • Willingness to work with additional Office tools

  • Fluent in German with good English skills

  • High level of engagement and on‑site presence

  • Solution‑oriented and self-managed working style

  • Team spirit and a motivated and collaborative mindset

What's in it for you?

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

ABB Motion provides pioneering technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators and drives for a wide range of applications in all industrial sectors.

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruiting process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician (Midlands / Bern Region) f/m/d (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this position, you will perform service activities in accordance with work instructions and ABB quality and safety guidelines. You will ensure excellent customer service on a daily basis by planning service assignments and executing them in line with customer requirements and expectations. Through your clear and professional communication, you will contribute to customer satisfaction and loyalty by providing transparent information regarding schedules, processes, and expectations.

Work model: Field-based

This role is part of the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden. Your key stakeholders will include customers, field service colleagues, and the internal service coordination team.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Collaborate with customers on-site to identify optimization opportunities and resolve existing challenges

  • Perform service assignments, identify technical issues, and conduct on-site or remote analysis within the service categories and product areas for which you are certified

  • Prepare material lists for service assignments and ensure that all required materials, spare parts, and tools are available, complete, and in proper working condition

  • Provide training to field service colleagues and customers as required

Our team

You will become part of a collaborative and supportive team where you can continue to grow both professionally and personally.

Your qualifications

  • Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician, Electrician, Electrical Installer, Electrical Planner, or a comparable technical qualification

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in automation, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; experience with UPS systems (uninterruptible power supply) is an advantage

  • Solid knowledge of electromechanical systems, diagnostic tools, and service processes in an industrial environment

  • Strong customer focus, flexibility in adapting to changing requirements, and a solution-oriented and collaborative approach to teamwork

  • Fluent German and basic English skills for professional communication with customers

  • Willingness to travel, participate in an on-call rotation, and occasionally work weekends; primary service area: Midlands / Bern region

  • Valid driver's license for assignments within Switzerland

Benefits

• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

  • Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)

  • Training, development, and career growth opportunities

  • Company vehicle and attractive fleet discounts

  • Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)

  • REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing facilities, critical infrastructure, and commercial buildings. The division's technical teams work closely with industry partners to develop innovative solutions that support growth, the energy transition, and sustainability goals.

Its portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting solutions, and safety devices such as switches and relays. The Power Protection business supports the world's largest data center companies with advanced and energy-efficient UPS solutions. In addition, ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable and user-friendly platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO₂ emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snello e più pulito.E ogni persona qui fa che accada. You.ll essere autorizzato a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che gestisce il mondo.

Questa posizione riporta a: Service Manager

E' un'idea divertente.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

In questa posizione, svolgerai attività di servizio in conformità con le istruzioni di lavoro e le linee guida per la qualità e la sicurezza ABB. Garantirai un servizio clienti eccellente su base giornaliera pianificando le assegnazioni di servizi e eseguendole in linea con le esigenze e le aspettative dei clienti. Attraverso la tua comunicazione chiara e professionale, contribuirai alla soddisfazione e alla fedeltà dei clienti fornendo informazioni trasparenti su orari, processi e aspettative.

Modello di lavoro: basato sul campo

Questo ruolo fa parte della divisione Electrification, Smart Power a Baden. I vostri principali stakeholder includeranno clienti, colleghi di servizio sul campo e il team di coordinamento interno del servizio.

Sarete responsabili principalmente di:

- Collaborare con i clienti in loco per individuare le opportunità di ottimizzazione e risolvere le sfide esistenti

- Eseguire incarichi di servizio, identificare problemi tecnici, e condurre analisi in loco o remota all'interno delle categorie di servizio e aree di prodotto per cui si sono certificati

- Preparare liste materiali per le assegnazioni di servizio e garantire che tutti i materiali, pezzi di ricambio e gli attrezzi necessari sono disponibili, completi, e in condizioni di lavoro adeguate

- Fornire formazione a colleghi e clienti del servizio sul campo come richiesto

La nostra squadra

Diventerai parte di un team collaborativo e di supporto dove potrai continuare a crescere sia professionalmente che personalmente.

Le tue qualifiche

- Formazione professionale completa come automazione TechNICan, elettricista, installatore elettrico, pianificatore elettrico, o una qualifica tecnica comparabile

- Almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale in automazione, ingegneria elettrica, o un campo tecnico correlato; esperienza con sistemi UPS (alimentazione non interrompibile) è un vantaggio

- Conoscenza solida di sistemi elettromeccanici, strumenti diagnostici e processi di servizio in un ambiente industriale

- Forte attenzione al cliente, flessibilità nell'adattarsi alle esigenze mutevoli e approccio al lavoro di squadra orientato alla soluzione e collaborativo

- Abilità fluenti in tedesco e inglese di base per la comunicazione professionale con i clienti

- Volontà di viaggiare, partecipazione ad una rotazione di servizio e occasionalmente fine settimana di lavoro; area di servizio primario: Midlands / regione di Berna

- Patente di guida valida per le assegnazioni in Svizzera

Prestazioni

• Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti una gamma di vantaggi interessanti, tra cui:

- Pacchetto di compensazione attraente compreso bonus, 13 ° mese di stipendio, e Dipendent Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)

- Possibilità di formazione, sviluppo e crescita professionale

- Auto aziendale e interessanti sconti flotta

- Contributi per i membri della palestra e i servizi medici (IFA)

- Voucher REKA e sconti tramite Swibeco

Più su di noi

ABB Smart Power fornisce soluzioni di distribuzione energetica per data center, impianti industriali e produttivi, infrastrutture critiche e edifici commerciali. I team tecnici della divisione lavorano a stretto contatto con i partner del settore per sviluppare soluzioni innovative che supportano la crescita, la transizione energetica e gli obiettivi di sostenibilità.

Il suo portafoglio comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, soluzioni per l'avviamento di motori e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. L'azienda Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center al mondo con soluzioni UPS avanzate ed efficienti sotto il profilo energetico. Inoltre, ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager fornisce una piattaforma di facile utilizzo e di scalabilità che aiuta le organizzazioni a risparmiare energia e ridurre le emissioni di CO2.

Il processo di reclutamento è gestito dal Partner di Acquisizione di Tante Emma Aslani.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede ogni tipo di mente: il curioso, il coraggioso e il creativo. Ecco perché accogliamo persone provenienti da ogni provenienza ed esperienza.

Pronto a fare un impatto?

Applica oggi o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

Unser Team

Ihre Qualifikationen

- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Automationstechniker, Elektriker, Elektroinstallations- und Elektroplaner oder vergleichbare technische Qualifikation

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Automatisierung, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich; Erfahrung mit USV-Systemen (ununterbrechbare Stromversorgung) ist ein Vorteil

- Solide Kenntnisse von elektromechanischen Systemen, Diagnosewerkzeugen und Serviceprozessen in einem industriellen Umfeld

- Starke Kundenorientierung, Flexibilität bei der Anpassung an sich verändernde Anforderungen und ein lösungsorientierter und kollaborativer Ansatz für Teamwork

- Fließende deutsche und grundlegende Englischkenntnisse für die professionelle Kommunikation mit Kunden

- Bereitschaft zu reisen, an einer Telefonumdrehung teilzunehmen, und gelegentlich am Wochenende; primärer Servicebereich: Midlands / Bern Region

- Gültiger Führerschein für Aufträge innerhalb der Schweiz

Vorteile

• Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern eine Reihe von attraktiven Vorteilen, darunter:

- Attraktive Vergütungspakete mit Bonus, Gehalt für 13 Monate und Erwerbsprogramm für Employee Share (ESAP)

- Weiterbildung, Entwicklung und Karrierechancen

- Unternehmen Fahrzeug und attraktive Flotte Rabatte

Mehr über uns

ABB Smart Power bietet Energieverteilungslösungen für Rechenzentren, Industrie- und Fertigungsanlagen, kritische Infrastruktur und gewerbliche Gebäude. Die technischen Teams des Geschäftsbereichs arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen, um innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen.

Das Portfolio umfasst industrielle Leistungsschalter, Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartlösungen und Sicherheitseinrichtungen wie Schalter und Relais. Das Power Protection-Geschäft unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen und energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

- Collaborer avec les clients sur place pour identifier les possibilités d'optimisation et résoudre les défis existants

- Effectuer des missions de service, identifier les problèmes techniques et effectuer des analyses sur place ou à distance dans les catégories de services et les secteurs de produits pour lesquels vous êtes certifié

- Préparer des listes de matériaux pour les affectations de service et s'assurer que tous les matériaux, pièces de rechange et outils requis sont disponibles, complets et en bon état de fonctionnement

- Offrir une formation aux collègues et aux clients des services sur le terrain, au besoin

Notre équipe

- Formation professionnelle terminée en tant que technicien d'automatisation, électricien, installateur électrique, planificateur électrique ou qualification technique comparable

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle en automatisation, en génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique connexe; l'expérience avec les systèmes UPS (alimentation électrique non interruptible) est un avantage

- Connaissance solide des systèmes électromécaniques, des outils de diagnostic et des processus de service dans un environnement industriel

- Une forte orientation client, une flexibilité dans l'adaptation aux besoins changeants et une approche collaborative et orientée vers la solution pour le travail d'équipe

- Compétences linguistiques allemandes et anglaises de base pour la communication professionnelle avec les clients

- Volonté de voyager, de participer à une rotation sur appel et de travailler occasionnellement les week-ends; zone de service primaire: Midlands / Berne

- Permis de conduire valide pour les affectations en Suisse

Avantages

• Nous offrons à nos employés une gamme de prestations attrayantes, notamment:

- Trousse de rémunération attrayante incluant la prime, le salaire de 13e mois et le Programme d'achat d'actions d'employé (PAES)

- Possibilités de formation, de perfectionnement et d'avancement professionnel

- Voitures d'entreprise et réductions attractives pour le parc automobile

- Contributions pour les membres de la salle de gymnastique et les services médicaux (IFA)
