At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact. We are looking for an R&D Hardware Engineer to join our Electrification business. The selected candidate will join a team working on High Power UPS product lines.

Work model: hybrid

Locations: Quartino, Ticino, Switzerland

Richmond Virginia United States of America

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Execute a variety of complex technology and engineering assignments. Understanding and applying applicable processes, standards, guidelines, and requirements, including architectural and design constraints.
  • Design system architectures, define technical specifications, perform circuit simulations, and develop projects requiring expertise in analog, digital, and power systems.
  • Optimize designs by identifying advanced technical, architectural, and circuitry solutions to maximize mechanical, electrical, and PCBA integration in collaboration with cross-functional product development teams.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for systems, components, and interfaces.

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering.
  • 2+ years of experience with electrical systems and complex power electronic systems.
  • Experience in digital and analog circuit design and simulation and hands-on experience with EMI design, mitigation, and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of environmental, reliability, and safety requirements for industrial products, as well as familiarity with product regulations and industry standards (including IEC and UL).
  • Proficiency in documentation systems, including Engineering Change Notifications (ECNs) and Bills of Materials (BOMs) and demonstrated ability to work effectively within a complex, cross-functional organization.
  • Excellent command of English (both written and verbal).
  • For the Richmond location: Candidates must hold a valid US work authorization permitting them to work for ABB in the United States

This position is managed by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will support the implementation of the local quality strategy, driving a strong quality culture, continuous improvement, and sustainable problem-solving. As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will ensure that all purchased materials and services meet ABB standards by qualifying suppliers, monitoring performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve world-class results.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Buildings / Supplier Business Excellence & Development in Schaffhausen.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Supplier Qualification & Audits: Qualify and approve new suppliers and conduct regular process, system, and product audits.

  • Quality • Requirements & FAI: Define and communicate quality requirements and lead First Article Inspections and qualification processes.

  • Performance Monitoring & Improvement: Track supplier performance using KPIs (e.g., PPM, OTD) and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Non-Conformance Management: Investigate quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure effective corrective actions (8D/CAPA).



• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field) or equivalent professional experience

  • Good knowledge of English and German (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus

  • Experience in supplier quality management and supplier audits (ISO 9001, VDA 6.3, IATF 16949 or similar)

  • Knowledge of APQP/PPAP and First Article Inspection (FAI)

  • Strong problem-solving skills using root cause analysis methods (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa)

  • Understanding of statistical quality methods (SPC, MSA, Gauge R&R)

  • Knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and material/component specifications



Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credit

  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Fitness allowance

  • Eco bonus



More about us
ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications.

The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager

__

ABB Electrification – Distribution Solutions develops technologies and solutions for safer, more reliable, and more sustainable electrical networks.

You will join the Sales Medium Voltage Switzerland team and contribute to the growth of ABB's business in French-speaking Switzerland, within a technical, dynamic, and strongly customer-focused environment.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving the commercial development of ABB's Medium Voltage products, solutions, and services across French-speaking Switzerland.

You will contribute to the sustainable growth, profitability, and strengthening of ABB's market presence within your territory.

You will manage your territory with a high degree of commercial autonomy and support opportunities from needs identification through to contract closing, working closely with various ABB teams.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will report to the Head of Sales Utilities & Industries Switzerland.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop and implement the sales strategy for ABB's Medium Voltage portfolio across French-speaking Switzerland, focusing on utilities, EPCs, system integrators, industrial customers, and other key market players.

  • Expand business within existing accounts while proactively identifying and securing new customers, applications, and growth opportunities through strong relationship management and customer engagement.

  • Manage the entire sales process from lead identification to contract award, including opportunity qualification, solution positioning, proposal strategy, pricing, sales forecasting, and commercial and contractual negotiations, in coordination with relevant legal and risk management functions.

  • Collaborate closely with Tendering, Product Marketing, Project Management, and Service teams to deliver competitive customer solutions, while monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and pricing developments to drive sustainable order, revenue, and profitability growth.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Higher education degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a comparable technical field.

  • Good knowledge of electrical power networks, particularly distribution networks; experience in the medium-voltage sector is a significant advantage.

  • Experience in B2B sales of technical products, systems, or solutions.

  • Strong customer focus and proven ability to develop long-term business relationships and identify new opportunities.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, self-motivation, and the ability to independently develop and manage a sales territory.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and collaboration skills, along with the ability to understand technical challenges and translate them into compelling customer value propositions.

  • Fluent French and good English skills; German is considered an advantage.


More about us
You will join the Sales Medium Voltage Switzerland team and contribute to the growth of ABB's business in French-speaking Switzerland, within a technical, dynamic, and strongly customer-focused environment.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager

__

ABB Electrification – Distribution Solutions develops technologies and solutions for safer, more reliable, and more sustainable electrical networks.

You will join the Sales Medium Voltage Switzerland team and contribute to the growth of ABB's business in French-speaking Switzerland, within a technical, dynamic, and strongly customer-focused environment.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving the commercial development of ABB's Medium Voltage products, solutions, and services across French-speaking Switzerland.

You will contribute to the sustainable growth, profitability, and strengthening of ABB's market presence within your territory.

You will manage your territory with a high degree of commercial autonomy and support opportunities from needs identification through to contract closing, working closely with various ABB teams.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will report to the Head of Sales Utilities & Industries Switzerland.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop and implement the sales strategy for ABB's Medium Voltage portfolio across French-speaking Switzerland, focusing on utilities, EPCs, system integrators, industrial customers, and other key market players.

  • Expand business within existing accounts while proactively identifying and securing new customers, applications, and growth opportunities through strong relationship management and customer engagement.

  • Manage the entire sales process from lead identification to contract award, including opportunity qualification, solution positioning, proposal strategy, pricing, sales forecasting, and commercial and contractual negotiations, in coordination with relevant legal and risk management functions.

  • Collaborate closely with Tendering, Product Marketing, Project Management, and Service teams to deliver competitive customer solutions, while monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and pricing developments to drive sustainable order, revenue, and profitability growth.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Higher education degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a comparable technical field.

  • Good knowledge of electrical power networks, particularly distribution networks; experience in the medium-voltage sector is a significant advantage.

  • Experience in B2B sales of technical products, systems, or solutions.

  • Strong customer focus and proven ability to develop long-term business relationships and identify new opportunities.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, self-motivation, and the ability to independently develop and manage a sales territory.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and collaboration skills, along with the ability to understand technical challenges and translate them into compelling customer value propositions.

  • Fluent French and good English skills; German is considered an advantage.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role you will have the opportunity to drive high quality life cycle management of critical power equipment: from developing new products and features to maintaining and improving existing solutions. Each day, you will use your skills and technical expertise to generate mechanical design requirements. You will also showcase your expertise by testing and documenting your designs for coordination with other technical teams within AU Critical Power.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Critical Power Agile Unit in Quartino, Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Contribute to the mechanical design, development, and documentation of new and enhanced critical power equipment, from concept through release and maintenance.

  • Collaborate across engineering and business functions to deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions that meet customer, project, and operational requirements.

  • Participate in design reviews, verification activities, and continuous improvement initiatives, incorporating feedback and driving product optimization.

  • Support prototype development and fabrication, ensuring successful validation, industrialization, and enhancement of products throughout their lifecycle.


Our team dynamics:
You will join a diverse and innovative team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • A University Degree in Mechanical Engineering with 2+ years of experience and knowledge of solid modeling CAD design software (Creo, etc.) required

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills. You are at ease communicating in English

  • Knowledge sheet metal design, detail part drawings, assembly drawings, and design for manufacturing.

  • Experience interpreting and applying electrical safety standards (UL/IEC, etc.). Experience in structural simulation and PLM software is a plus.

More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities


In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to successful project results in technology, software, product, and/or solution development, as well as associated Intellectual Property (IP). Each day, you will act as the first point of contact in Research and Development for specific product-related issues and maintenance. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying, proposing, and implementing innovative solutions.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the ABB MOTR Traction organization in Untersiggenthal Switzerland. Main stakeholders are the Traction R&D management and System Engineering organization

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Design and develop embedded software for real-time and embedded VxWorks and Linux systems.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable products.

  • Architect and maintain DevSecOps pipelines enabling automated build, test, security scanning, and release processes.

  • Implement secure coding practices and drive cybersecurity compliance throughout the software lifecycle.

  • Develop automated testing frameworks and ensure high software quality and reliability.

  • Lead code reviews, technical mentoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Manage software configuration, release management, and lifecycle support activities.

  • Drive the adoption of modern DevSecOps and Secure SDLC best practices across engineering teams.


You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing and international team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Solid degree in computer science, electrical engineering or electronics

  • You have at least 5 years of experience in embedded real time software engineering, applying modern C/C++ concepts. Python is an advantage

  • You are passionate about agile methodologies in SW engineering applying SCRUM in a SAFe® value creation Framework

  • Ability to demonstrate your experience with DevSecOps producing high-quality code that qualifies for Cyber Security Standards like IEC 62443 and CRA.

  • Possess strong analysis and complex problem-solving skills

  • You are qualified in the use of Azure DevOps, Git version control and Jenkins CI/CD.

  • Experience in working with Linux based system, preferably Real Time Linux

  • You are at ease communicating in English, German is advantageous.

IPU Leader Buy&Sell

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead a team within a Production unit or line to execute production processes, transforming parts and raw materials into ABB products in a timely and cost-effective manner. Each day, you will ensure continuous and efficient operation in accordance with volumes, schedules, procedures, drawings, and quality and safety standards and policies.   • Verwaltung von Fertigungs- und Feldrückgabeaktivitäten für Unterbaugruppen, Koordinierung von Inspektions-, Test-, Nacharbeits- und Dispositionsprozessen mit Qualitäts-, Engineering- und Serviceteams, um die Produktqualität und die Einhaltung der Fertigungsstandards sicherzustellen.

Sie werden einem dynamischen und kollaborativen -Team beitreten, in dem Sie gedeihen können.

  • Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.

Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung von Produktionsteams, der Verwaltung des täglichen Betriebs und der Erreichung der Ziele für Sicherheit, Qualität, Lieferung und Produktivität.
  • Starke Kenntnisse in Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, 5S und strukturierten Problemlösungsmethoden.
  • Gute Kenntnisse in SAP.
  • Starke analytische, organisatorische und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten mit einer proaktiven und ergebnisorientierten Denkweise.

jobs.title: R&D Engineer – Embedded Firmware (80 - 100%) f/m/d
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__


In this role, you will develop embedded firmware for UPS power supply systems, working across real-time operating systems, microcontroller platforms, hardware interfaces, testing, and cybersecurity compliance. You will help deliver reliable, secure, and maintainable firmware solutions in a global engineering environment.

• Your responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and debug embedded C firmware for UPS power supply systems using FreeRTOS on ARM Cortex and TI microcontroller platforms, including hardware abstraction layers and interfaces such as GPIO, interrupts, timers, and communication protocols.
  • Build and execute automated and integration tests using gTest or similar frameworks, applying best practices for code quality, maintainability, and compliance with standards such as EU CRA and IEC 62443.
  • Collaborate with design, testing, and cybersecurity teams to deliver reliable firmware, and use Git, build systems, and CI/CD practices to support efficient software development and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrate ownership, clear communication, and attention to detail while continuously learning and contributing within an Agile engineering environment.

Your background

  • Degree in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with 3–5 years of embedded systems or firmware development experience.
  • Strong embedded C/C++ skills; experience with Python or another scripting language is a plus.
  • Knowledge of ARM Cortex, TI microcontrollers, FreeRTOS, and embedded communication protocols such as SPI, UART, I2C, RS485, Modbus, or CAN.
  • Hands-on experience with hardware debugging, firmware integration, Git, build systems, and structured software development practices.
  • Experience with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Ethernet/IP, CAN, or IEC 61850, and with HMI panels or HMI design tools.
  • Familiarity with Node.js or IoT communication layers, plus understanding of power electronics and UPS architecture, including battery management, power conversion, and thermal management.
  • Fluent in English and Italian language skills and Agile experience are considered a plus.

More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader in electrification, delivering smart, connected, and protected power solutions. Our UPS Product Line improves energy efficiency, reliability, and security for critical applications worldwide. We value people from different backgrounds and welcome applications from candidates who want to help shape a more sustainable and resilient future.

- Costruire ed eseguire test automatizzati ed integrati utilizzando quadri gTest o simili, applicando le migliori pratiche per la qualità dei codici, la manutenzione e il rispetto di standard quali CRA UE e IEC 62443.

Il tuo passato

- Conoscenza di ARM Cortex, microcontrollori TI, FreeRTOS, e protocolli di comunicazione incorporati come SPI, UART, I2C, RS485, Modbus, o CAN.

- Entwickeln, pflegen und Debug eingebettete C-Firmware für USV-Netzversorgungssysteme mit FreeRTOS auf ARM Cortex- und TI-Mikrocontroller-Plattformen, einschließlich Hardware-Abstraktionsschichten und Schnittstellen wie GPIO, Interrupts, Timer und Kommunikationsprotokolle.

- Aufbau und Durchführung von automatisierten Tests und Integrationstests mit gTest oder ähnlichen Frameworks, die bewährte Verfahren für die Codequalität, die Wartungsfähigkeit und die Einhaltung von Standards wie EU CRA und IEC 62443 anwenden.

- Zusammenarbeit mit Design-, Test- und Cybersicherheitsteams, um zuverlässige Firmware zu liefern, und Einsatz von Git, Build-Systemen und CI/CD-Praktiken, um eine effiziente Softwareentwicklung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu unterstützen.

- Nachweis von Eigentum, klarer Kommunikation und Liebe zum Detail, während kontinuierlich lernen und einen Beitrag innerhalb eines agilen Engineering-Umgebung.

- Ich weiß.

Ihr Hintergrund

- Abschluss in Software Engineering, Elektrotechnik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit 3–5 Jahren eingebetteten Systemen oder Firmware-Entwicklung Erfahrung.

- Starke C /C++ Fähigkeiten; Erfahrung mit Python oder einer anderen Skriptsprache ist ein Plus.

- Kenntnisse von ARM Cortex, TI microcontrollers, FreeRTOS und eingebetteten Kommunikationsprotokollen wie SPI, UART, I2C, RS485, Modbus oder CAN.

- Hands-on Erfahrung mit Hardware-Debugging, Firmware-Integration, Git, Build-Systeme und strukturierte Software-Entwicklungspraktiken.

- Erfahrungen mit industriellen Kommunikationsprotokollen wie Modbus, Ethernet/IP, CAN oder IEC 61850, und mit HMI-Panels oder HMI-Design-Tools.

- Vertrautheit mit Node.js oder IoT-Kommunikationsschichten, sowie Verständnis der Leistungselektronik und UPS-Architektur, einschließlich Batteriemanagement, Stromumwandlung und thermisches Management.

- Fließende Englisch- und Italienischkenntnisse und Agile-Erfahrung gelten als Plus.

Mehr über uns

ABB Smart Power ist ein weltweit führender Technologieführer in der Elektrifizierung, liefert intelligente, vernetzte und geschützte Stromversorgungslösungen. Unsere USV-Produktlinie verbessert Energieeffizienz, Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit für kritische Anwendungen weltweit. Wir schätzen Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und begrüßen Anwendungen von Kandidaten, die dabei helfen wollen, eine nachhaltigere und widerstandsfähigere Zukunft zu gestalten.

Dieser Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner bei ABB Schweiz, geleitet.

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

Bereit, einen Schlag zu machen?

jobs.title: (80 – 100%) IS Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IS Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide technical, business process and data advice to support ongoing operations and new software development. Each day, you will expand and utilize your knowledge on IS applications and emerging technologies. You will also showcase your expertise by overseeing the development, and validating the functionality, of the final IS application.

This role is contributing to all local divisions in Switzerland. Main stakeholders are business process owners, application owners and function managers across all organizational levels as well as local and global IS teams (architects, developers, IS security specialists, compliance specialists).

You will join a diverse and committed team where we support each other’s, and in which a self-reliant allrounder finds space to explore, grow, and excel.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid (min. 60% on site)


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Jointly with business stakeholders formulating user stories which document and "translate" business requirements into specifications for local or global development/support teams. Collaborating with these teams to ensure the use case and business user needs are understood.
  • Acting as a Subject Matter Expert in ongoing operations of IS applications, and participating in projects to introduce new or modify existing IS solutions/services, by contributing technology, business process and data expertise.
  • Supporting IS application power-users in resolving incidents and in further developing the functionality. Supporting them also in validating and user acceptance testing IS application solutions in stage environment. Formulating test scripts according to acceptance criteria.
  • Managing a specific IS application (for management of industrial standards), including budget responsibility. Providing efficient, requirement-compliant, and cost-effective provision and procurement of services for internal user groups.

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • Higher education degree in Computer Science or Business Informatics (University, University of Applied Sciences) or equivalent.
  • Fluent English and good German language skills (spoken and written).
  • Practical experience as an IS Functional Analyst or Business Analyst, preferably in an international environment. Experience as an IS Application Manager or IS Service Manager is advantageous.
  • Commitment to building trusted relationships to and consensus among various stakeholders. Ability to collaborate and communicate self-reliantly with all management levels.
  • Practical experience in requirements analysis and change management, as well as with the Software Development Lifecycle. Scrum or general Agile knowledge and Design Thinking knowledge are advantageous.
  • Talent and fondness for planning, organization, coordination, and communication.
  • Experience with or interest in industrial standards management or document management is an advantage.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

At ABB, we develop battery systems and traction solutions that power trains, mining equipment, and industrial applications around the world. We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our battery development team in Untersiggenthal and contribute to the next generation of energy storage solutions.

This is an opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary environment alongside experts in battery technology, thermal management, materials, manufacturing, testing, and system engineering. We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex engineering challenges, and turning innovative ideas into practical solutions.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Motion Traction Energy Storage Solutions (ESS) Product Line in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading mechanical development activities for battery systems and related components throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Owning technical work packages from concept development through validation and industrialization.

  • Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including electrical, systems, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and product management experts.

  • Driving technical improvements, supporting innovation initiatives, and contributing to the development of future product platforms.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.

  • Solid experience in the design and development of complex mechanical products and assemblies.

  • Strong knowledge of manufacturing technologies such as sheet metal forming, extrusion, and injection molding.

  • Proven experience working with customers, suppliers, and international project teams.

  • Extensive experience with 3D CAD and PLM/PDM systems, ideally PTC Creo and Windchill.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, including structural design, material selection, and design for manufacturing.

  • Experience in battery systems or energy storage solutions is considered an advantage but is not required.

  • Fluent communication skills in both German and English.

More about us

Diese Position berichtet an: F&E Team Lead

Bei ABB entwickeln wir Batteriesysteme und Traktionslösungen, die weltweit die Kraft der Züge, Bergbauanlagen und industriellen Anwendungen nutzen. Das Modell der Rolle ist: #LI-Hybrid

Diese Rolle trägt zur Motion Traction Energy Storage Solutions (ESS) Produktlinie in der Schweiz bei.

- Führende mechanische Entwicklungsaktivitäten für Batteriesysteme und zugehörige Komponenten während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.

- Besitz technischer Arbeitspakete von der Konzeptentwicklung über die Validierung und Industrialisierung.

- enge Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, einschließlich Elektrik, Systeme, Fertigung, Qualität, Lieferkette und Produktmanagement-Experten.

- technische Verbesserungen, Unterstützung von Innovationsinitiativen und Beitrag zur Entwicklung künftiger Produktplattformen.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

- Bachelor, Master, Maschinenbau.

- Solide Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Entwicklung komplexer mechanischer Produkte und Baugruppen.

- Starke Kenntnisse der Fertigungstechnologien wie Blechumformung, Extrusion und Spritzguss.

- Bewährte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Lieferanten und internationalen Projektteams.

- Umfangreiche Erfahrung mit 3D CAD und PLM/PDM Systemen, idealerweise PTC Creo und Windchill.

- Ein starkes Verständnis der mechanischen Grundlagen, einschließlich der Konstruktion, Materialauswahl und Konstruktion für die Fertigung.

- Die Erfahrung mit Batteriesystemen oder Energiespeicherlösungen gilt als Vorteil, ist aber nicht erforderlich.

- Fließende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch.

Mehr über uns

Sie werden sich einem erfahrenen und kollaborativen Engineering-Team anschließen, das über alle Aspekte der Batteriesystementwicklung hinweg eine tiefe Expertise besitzt.
• Wir bieten ein Umfeld, das Eigentümerschaft, kontinuierliches Lernen und Innovation fördert, wo Ihre Ideen direkte Auswirkungen auf Produkte haben können, die weltweit in anspruchsvollen Transport- und Industrieanwendungen eingesetzt werden.

Wenn Sie echte technische Herausforderungen lösen, mit talentierten Kollegen zusammenarbeiten und zu nachhaltigen Energielösungen beitragen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Support Manager

__

To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a dedicated, experienced Project Engineer. In this role, you take responsibility as a technical authority for electrical engineering projects with low to medium complexity – particularly for medium-voltage, low-voltage and standby power systems in the service business (retrofit). You implement the requirements of concepts within the specified time and budget framework and ensure that all specifications, quality standards, safety requirements and standards are consistently met.


Work Model: #hybrid
Business Line: Service (Division Electrification)

Your responsibilities

  • Product configuration, creation of electrical schematics using EPLAN and preparation of simple mechanical drawings using AutoCAD

  • Creation of selectivity calculations

  • Execution of type testing (design verifications) for non-standard configurations based on checklists and applicable standards

  • Technical support during tests and commissioning and support of project management in technical reviews, customer meetings and implementation of change and variation requests

  • Development of effort estimates and feasibility recommendations for the quotation team

  • Preparation of system documentation, as-built documents and acceptance records

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an electrician or automation technician plus further training as a technician HF/FH or comparable qualification

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in project engineering, ideally in energy technology. Experience in mechanical engineering is an advantage.

  • Very good CAD skills in EPLAN Electric P8; AutoCAD skills are an advantage

  • Technical understanding of the engineering of power supply systems (MV/LV/emergency supply power), ideally with experience with low-voltage switchgear

  • Strong focus on safe working practices and commitment to compliance with all relevant safety guidelines

  • Very high self-motivation as well as independent, solution-oriented and responsible working methods

  • Team player with a cooperative approach and good communication skills; you are fluent in German and English – French language skills are an advantage

What We Offer

  • Attractive and performance-based compensation

  • Flexible working models (hybrid)

  • Comprehensive further training and development opportunities

  • Modern working environment and international collaboration

  • Occupational social benefits and employee discounts

More About Us

ABB is a leading technology company that stands for a sustainable and high-performing future. Our solutions are active in the areas of electrification, automation and digitalization and help transform the way we live and work. Visit www.abb.com for more information about our solutions worldwide.

Ready to make an impact?

This position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours, in line with business strategies focused on quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, and equipment performance, work instruction, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also showcase your skills by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to meet the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Power Protection department in Quartino, Switzerland.

  • Drive Improvement Projects – Identify opportunities, implement projects, and ensure adherence to timeframe, quality, and cost.

  • Production Support – Assist during process/equipment start-up, define action plans, and train maintenance and production teams.

  • Technology Evaluation – Assess new process technologies to boost productivity, quality, and cost efficiency, leading testing and provider selection.


• Qualifications for the role

  • A degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering.

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in operations and production line activities.

  • Knowledge of Engineering & Manufacturing Processes.

  • Proficiency in MS Office and 2D/3D CAD systems (CREO and/or SolidWorks required).

  • Positive spirit, Proactivity, teamwork, speediness, and problem-solving mindset; commitment to deliver results by taking responsibility for assigned tasks and projects.

  • Fluent in English.

More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation.

This position is managed by Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Business Manager – Energy Storage System

__

Business and Division Description

ABB Traction plays a critical role in shaping the future of electrified mobility. Through our traction battery packs and energy storage solutions, we enable customers globally to achieve higher efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in rail and off highway applications. We combine global scale with strong local execution to deliver performance, innovation, and long-term value.

Location

This role is open globally for ABB employees, but location is set in Switzerland. The work model is hybrid #LI-hybrid.

Key • Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the newly established ESS R&D organization together with the team leaders and around 30 individual contributors – aligned with the Division and Product Line strategy

  • Establish technical thought-leadership and expertise in all relevant disciplines spanning from battery cells to battery systems – nurture an innovation pipeline to stay ahead of the competition

  • Own the ESS R&D budget and manage technology roadmaps, projects, and priorities in close alignment with the ESS product management function.

  • Establish a strong outside-in and customer-oriented culture aligned with the ABB values, courage, care, curiosity and collaboration

  • Build, develop and maintain strong relationships with all relevant internal and external stakeholders – ensure clarity at the interfaces to other functions, such as engineering, production and supply chain management

  • Take full responsibility for a safe working environment and for the correct implementation of guidelines and processes.

• Qualifications

  • Master degree in a STEM discipline

  • Proven direct leadership skills, with a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills

  • Experience in leading product or platform development in the field of propulsion or battery energy storage systems

  • Knowledge of industry standards and development processes relevant to railway and e-mobility applications

  • A high level of self-motivation, ownership, curiosity, and strong drive to stay one inch ahead

  • Must be fluent in English, fluency in German a strong plus

  • Candidates from the Traction Division will be given preferential consideration

What’s in it for you?

We give you the space to lead, the support to grow, and the chance to make a difference. Whether you're solving problems, building something new, or helping others succeed, your impact is real. You’ll be part of a team that values your voice and celebrates your progress. The position reports to the Head of the Product Line ESS.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will play a key role in the installation, maintenance, and repair of UPS systems and battery installations. You will diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently, ensuring reliable and cost-effective solutions for our customers. Working in accordance with ABB policies, procedures, and safety standards, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of product quality and reliability. Leveraging your technical expertise and customer-focused approach, you will build strong relationships with customers and support the identification of new business opportunities. You will operate within ABB's established processes and quality standards, helping to deliver excellent service and customer satisfaction.


The work model for the role is: onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Power Business in Baden, Kanton Aargau.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Perform and coordinate repair and maintenance activities on UPS systems and battery installations, including fault diagnosis, testing, and inspections.

  • Manage and maintain loan equipment and UPS modules.

  • Ensure the proper maintenance and availability of tools, equipment, and testing facilities.

  • Assist with inventory and warehouse management, including the procurement of spare parts and consumable materials.

​

• Qualifications for the role

  • Successfully completed vocational training in Electrical Engineering (Electrician, Electrical Installer, Electronics Technician, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience working with UPS systems, battery installations, and power electronics.

  • Fluent German language skills; English and Italian proficiency is considered a plus.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Reliable, proactive, and customer-focused, with a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to work independently.

​

Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credits

  • Exclusive employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Contribution towards fitness and health programs

  • Eco Bonus (sustainability incentive)

More about us
ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.


This recruitment process is being managed by Talent Partner Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Real Estate Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Real Estate Portfolio Strategy Specialist, you will play a key role in shaping and executing ABB Switzerland’s real estate portfolio strategy, with a strong focus on investment, optimization, and divestment projects for ABB‑owned and leased sites.

You will manage complex and often confidential initiatives, coordinating closely with internal stakeholders (Business, Legal, Controlling, Accounting, Tax, Public Affairs) as well as external consultants, authorities, and transaction partners. Your ability to navigate financial, legal, and operational topics in parallel, while maintaining governance and timelines, will be critical to your success.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Lead the development and execution of ABB's real estate portfolio and workplace strategies, ensuring alignment with business priorities, growth plans, and workplace transformation objectives while driving portfolio efficiency, occupancy optimization, cost effectiveness, and long-term value creation.

  • Manage complex real estate transactions and portfolio initiatives, including investments, divestments, consolidations, restructurings, lease events, and workplace transformation projects across owned and leased facilities, ensuring compliance with governance processes, financial targets, approval requirements, and risk management standards.

  • Drive portfolio performance and decision-making through robust financial and operational analysis, including business case development, occupancy cost assessments, ROI evaluations, scenario modeling, utilization reviews, vacancy analysis, and portfolio recommendations to support local and global senior management.

  • Act as a senior business partner and project leader, collaborating with business, finance, legal, HR, procurement, landlords, developers, authorities, and external advisors to forecast future space demand, oversee due diligence and lease negotiations, and deliver real estate solutions that enhance employee experience, sustainability performance, operational effectiveness, and financial outcomes.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio management, development, transactions, or a related field, with solid knowledge of the Swiss real estate and construction market.

  • Bachelor’s degree in real estate, Business Administration, Finance, or comparable discipline.

  • Strong financial acumen, including the ability to analyze and interpret financial statements, evaluate investment and divestment business cases, assess risks and returns, and support fact‑based decision‑making at management level.

  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and service‑oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently in a dynamic and demanding environment.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence interacting at senior management level.

  • Strong organizational and project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Fluency in German and English is essential.

More about us

Our mission in Real Estate (RE) is to enable ABB businesses to perform at their best through a global real estate management that covers the full end-to-end lifecycle from site selection, management and maintenance to site termination. We have a passion for operational excellence and make every effort to create value for ABB businesses. Our efforts grow out of a commitment to provide healthy and engaging work environments, improve energy efficiency and sustainability and optimize space efficiency for all our buildings in more than 100 countries all over the world. We value people from different backgrounds.

Could this be your story?

Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated).

The recruiting process is led by Gema de Vicente, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Sales Support Specialist w/m/d (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Support Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will support ABB Switzerland’s local sales organization as well as our customers throughout the entire quotation process in the field of drive technology. You will act as the central technical point of contact within your area of responsibility and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders on a daily basis.


• Your responsibilities include optimally sizing products for customers to best meet their requirements and applicable standards. In addition, you will calculate costs and prepare quotations with the relevant technical information. You will apply your technical expertise in a targeted manner and make a significant contribution to the successful preparation of proposals.


Work model: Hybrid


This position supports the local sales unit (Motion) in Baden, Canton Aargau.


Your main responsibilities

  • Technical consulting & solution development: You support sales and customers in selecting technically optimal and economically viable solutions for drive and automation systems.
  • End-to-end quotation management: You prepare and calculate technical and commercial quotations and support them through to successful completion.
  • Analysis & optimization: You analyze customer needs, market and competitor information, as well as lost opportunities, and derive targeted improvement measures.
  • Collaboration & quality assurance: You work closely with sales, business units, and other stakeholders and ensure compliance with quality, compliance, and HSE standards.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed technical education (e.g., automation technician, electronics technician, automation specialist, or similar)
  • Several years of professional experience (min. 5 years) in sales support, sales, or project environments
  • Very good German skills and good English skills, both written and spoken
  • Strong customer orientation and excellent communication skills
  • Analytical mindset and understanding of markets and processes
  • Initiative, structured way of working, and assertiveness
  • Advantageous: French language skills and further education at HF level (e.g., certified technician HF)

Benefits

• We offer, among others:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
  • Eco bonus

More about us

ABB Motion provides industrial customers with cutting-edge technologies, products, solutions, and related services to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and ensure precise control of processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators, and drives for a wide range of applications across all industries.


The recruitment process is managed by Ece Özen, Talent Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Sales Support Manager

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Funktion unterstützen Sie die lokale Vertriebsorganisation von ABB Schweiz sowie unsere Kunden während des gesamten Angebotsprozesses im Bereich Antriebstechnik. Sie agieren als zentraler technischer Ansprechpartner in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich und arbeiten täglich eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen.


• Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehört die optimale Dimensionierung der Produkte, damit die Kunden ihre Anforderungen und geltenden Standards bestmöglich erfüllen können. Darüber hinaus berechnen Sie Kosten und erstellen Angebote mit den relevanten technischen Informationen. Sie bringen Ihre technische Expertise gezielt ein und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Erstellung von Vorschlägen.


Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid


Diese Position unterstützt die lokale Vertriebseinheit (Motion) in Baden, Kanton Aargau.


Ihre Hauptaufgaben

  • Technische Beratung & Lösungsentwicklung: Sie unterstützen Vertrieb und Kunden bei der Auswahl technisch optimaler und wirtschaftlich tragfähiger Lösungen für Antriebs- und Automatisierungssysteme.
  • End-to-End-Angebotsmanagement: Sie erstellen und berechnen technische und kaufmännische Angebote und unterstützen sie bis zur erfolgreichen Fertigstellung.
  • Analyse & Optimierung: Sie analysieren Kundenbedürfnisse, Markt- und Wettbewerberinformationen sowie verpasste Chancen und leiten daraus gezielte Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab.
  • Zusammenarbeit & Qualitätssicherung: Sie arbeiten eng mit Vertrieb, Geschäftseinheiten und anderen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgen für die Einhaltung der Qualitäts-, Compliance- und HSE-Standards.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z. B. Automatisierungstechniker, Elektroniktechniker, Automatisierungsspezialist oder ähnliches)
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mindestens 5 Jahre) in Sales Support, Sales oder Projektumgebungen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse, sowohl schriftlich als auch gesprochen
  • Starke Kundenorientierung und ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeit
    • Analytische Denkweise und Verständnis von Märkten und Prozessen
  • Initiative, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Durchsetzungsvermögen
  • Vorteil: Französische Sprachkenntnisse und Weiterbildung auf HF-Niveau

Benefits

>Vorteilig: Französische Sprachkenntnisse und Weiterbildung auf HF-Niveau (z.B. zertifizierter Techniker HF)

Benefits

• Wir bieten unter anderem an:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
    • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
    • Eco bonus

Mehr über uns

ABB Motion bietet Industriekunden modernste Technologien, Produkte, Lösungen und damit verbundene Dienstleistungen, um die Energieeffizienz zu erhöhen, die Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit zu verbessern und eine präzise Kontrolle der Prozesse zu gewährleisten. Das Portfolio umfasst Motoren, Generatoren und Antriebe für eine Vielzahl von Anwendungen in allen Branchen.


Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Ece Özen, Talent Partner, geleitet.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire du soutien aux ventes

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous soutiendrez l'organisation de vente locale ABB Suisse ainsi que nos clients tout au long du processus de soumission dans le domaine de la technologie d'entraînement. Vous agirez comme point de contact technique central dans votre secteur de responsabilité et collaborerez quotidiennement étroitement avec les intervenants internes et externes.


• Vos responsabilités incluent des produits de taille optimale pour les clients afin de répondre au mieux à leurs exigences et aux normes applicables. En outre, vous calculerez les coûts et préparerez les devis avec les informations techniques pertinentes. Vous appliquerez votre expertise technique de façon ciblée et apporterez une contribution importante à la préparation réussie des propositions.


Modèle de travail : hybride


Ce poste appuie l'unité de vente locale (Motion) de Baden, Canton d'Argovie.


Vos principales responsabilités

  • Conseil technique & développement de solutions: Vous aidez les ventes et les clients à choisir des solutions techniquement optimales et économiquement viables pour les systèmes d'entraînement et d'automatisation.
  • Gestion des devis de bout en bout : Vous préparez et calculez les devis techniques et commerciaux et les supportez jusqu'à leur achèvement.
  • Analyse et optimisation : Vous analysez les besoins des clients, les informations sur le marché et les concurrents, ainsi que les possibilités perdues, et vous obtenez des mesures d'amélioration ciblées.
    • Collaboration et assurance de la qualité : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les ventes, les unités opérationnelles et d'autres intervenants et vous assurez la conformité aux normes de qualité, de conformité et d'ESH.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Formation technique complète (p. ex. technicien en automatisation, technicien en électronique, spécialiste de l'automatisation ou similaire)
  • Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle (min. 5 ans) dans le soutien aux ventes, les ventes ou les environnements de projets
  • Très bonnes compétences en allemand et bonnes compétences en anglais, à la fois écrites et parlées
  • Orientation du client et excellentes compétences en communication
  • Analyse de l'état d'esprit et compréhension des marchés et des processus
  • Mode de travail initial, structuré et d'affirmation de soi
  • Avantage : compétences en français et formation continue au niveau HF (p. ex. technicien certifié HF)

Avantages

• Nous offrons, entre autres :

  • Plan d'acquisition d'actions d'employés (PAES)
  • Crédit REKA
  • Réductions d'employés (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Congé parental
  • Indemnité de liquidité
  • Bonus Eco

En savoir plus sur nous

AB Motion fournit aux clients industriels des technologies, des produits, des solutions et des services de pointe pour accroître l'efficacité énergétique, améliorer la sécurité et la fiabilité et assurer un contrôle précis des processus. Le portefeuille comprend des moteurs, des générateurs et des lecteurs pour un large éventail d'applications dans toutes les industries.


Le processus de recrutement est géré par Ece Özen, Talent Partner.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact ?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier.

jobs.title: Service Team Leader (f/m/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead a regional service team with diverse expertise in service planning, order processing, and service execution within the Electrification business area. Together with your team, you will ensure comprehensive customer support for Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems across the German-speaking region of Switzerland.


Reporting directly to the Head of Service UPS Systems, you will make a significant contribution to the implementation of the service strategy and the promotion of business growth. Through efficient planning and targeted allocation of resources, while ensuring compliance with established processes, procedures, and guidelines, you will drive high service quality and operational excellence.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading, coaching, and developing a regional service team consisting of Service Coordinators, Order Handling Specialists, Technical Support Engineers, and Field Service Technicians, while fostering a motivating, safe, and performance-oriented work environment.
  • Taking overall responsibility for all service activities, customer orders, and maintenance operations within the region, ensuring the achievement of quality, performance, and commercial targets, maintaining customer relationships, and delivering high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Providing operational support to the team (approximately 60% of the role) in service planning (FSL), including the review and approval of weekly reports and expense claims.
  • Ensuring the implementation of and compliance with all occupational health and safety requirements.


Your • Qualifications

  • Technical vocational training in Electrical Engineering, complemented by a job-related advanced qualification at Higher Technical College level (e.g., Certified Technician, Master Craftsman, or equivalent).
  • Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in the maintenance, servicing, commissioning, and repair of electrical installations.
  • Experience with power electronics and/or UPS systems.
  • Several years of leadership experience in a similar position.
  • A flexible and resilient personality with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • A structured and solution-oriented approach to work and problem-solving.
  • Willingness to travel throughout Switzerland.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications as well as SAP or other ERP systems.
  • Excellent German and English language skills, both written and spoken; French and Italian are an advantage.


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:


  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credits
  • Exclusive employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Contribution towards fitness and health programs
  • Eco Bonus (sustainability incentive)


More About Us

ABB’s Service Division partners with customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability, and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The division’s comprehensive service portfolio includes product care, modernization, and consulting services designed to enhance performance, extend equipment lifetime, and achieve new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help our customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, maximize the value derived from them, and recover and regenerate products and materials at the end of their lifecycle.


This recruitment process is being managed by Talent Partner Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Department Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Research Scientist, you will be working on sensing solutions for ABB’s next generation systems and products. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contributing to and leading research projects in the field of sensors and industrial sensing applications addressing the needs of our businesses, with applications including automation, process industries, and electrification.
  • Together with multidisciplinary project teams, develop novel, high-value sensing products and solutions from the concept definition phase to the experimental verification.
  • Evaluate new technologies and conduct technical surveys, generate project proposals with business impact and collaborate with researchers and engineers from other research centers, ABB business units, as well as from universities.
  • Disseminate your results with scientific publications and internal technical reports, generate intellectual property.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD university degree in electrical engineering, computer science, or related field
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in signal processing and data analytics (including ML/deep-learning-based) e.g. denoising, feature extraction, time-series analysis and anomaly detection, signal classification and pattern recognition
  • Hands-on experience with test, design, simulation and validation of electronic systems, embedded electronics, (wireless-) connectivity, testing methodologies and data-driven validation, edge/embedded ML deployment
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes
  • Strong interest in sensing technologies and integration of sensors in systems. Context knowledge in electrification-related applications considered as a plus
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (C/C++, Python, Matlab and modern ML frameworks -PyTorch-), and use of coding agents
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude and excellent command (written & oral) of the English language

More about us

The ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil, Switzerland, is where we investigate new technologies which support and drive the development of ABB’s next-generation products and solutions. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application, including CV, cover letter and list of publications. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com. This position is managed by Pedro Labian (Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland).

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Joignez-vous à nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de:

Gestionnaire du département de recherche

Votre rôle et responsabilités

En tant que chercheur scientifique, vous travaillerez sur des solutions de détection pour les systèmes et produits de prochaine génération d'ABB. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un membre de l'équipe qui possède une expérience de recherche éprouvée et qui est désireux de transférer et d'appliquer la recherche universitaire de classe mondiale dans un environnement industriel. Vous travaillerez au sein de l'équipe internationale hautement motivée de scientifiques d'ABB Research. • Nous offrons un milieu de travail ouvert et innovateur offrant de nombreuses possibilités d'avancement professionnel.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-hybrid

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Contribuer et diriger des projets de recherche dans le domaine des capteurs et des applications de détection industrielle répondant aux besoins de nos entreprises, y compris les applications d'automatisation, les industries de procédés et l'électrification.
  • En collaboration avec des équipes de projet multidisciplinaires, élaborer de nouveaux produits et solutions de détection à haute valeur ajoutée depuis la phase de définition du concept jusqu'à la vérification expérimentale.
    • Évaluer les nouvelles technologies et mener des enquêtes techniques, produire des propositions de projets ayant un impact sur les entreprises et collaborer avec des chercheurs et des ingénieurs d'autres centres de recherche, des unités d'affaires d'ABB ainsi que des universités.
    • Diffuser vos résultats avec des publications scientifiques et des rapports techniques internes, générer la propriété intellectuelle.


    • Qualifications pour le rôle

    • Doctorat universitaire en génie électrique, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe
    • Connaissances théoriques et pratiques en traitement des signaux et en analyse des données (y compris ML/deep-learning-based) ex. dénigrement, extraction de fonctions, analyse de séries chronologiques et détection d'anomalies, classification des signaux et reconnaissance des patrons
    • Expérience pratique de l'essai, de la conception, de la simulation et de la validation des systèmes électroniques, de l'électronique embarquée, de la connectivité (sans fil), des méthodes d'essai et de la validation axée sur les données, du déploiement de ML bord/embed
    • Expérience solide d'obtenir des idées des concepts aux prototypes
    • Intérêt marqué pour les technologies de détection et l'intégration des capteurs dans les systèmes. Connaissance du contexte dans les applications liées à l'électrification considérées comme un plus
    • Compétence dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation (C/C++, Python, Matlab et les cadres ML modernes -PyTorch-), et utilisation d'agents de codage
    • Excellentes compétences en communication et attitude de joueur d'équipe et excellente commande (écrite et orale) de la langue anglaise

    Plus d'informations sur nous

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this versatile role, you will be responsible for the successful execution of customer projects involving medium-voltage switchgear and other electrical engineering solutions for the Swiss market. You will manage your projects from order handover through delivery and successful completion, acting as the central point of contact for our customers.

You will work closely with the project and engineering teams at our international supply factories as well as with local specialist functions. You will manage a portfolio of projects of varying sizes and ensure compliance with schedule, cost, quality, and contractual requirements.

The work model for this position is: Hybrid #LI-hybrid

This position is part of the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland.

Your main responsibilities

  • End-to-end project responsibility: Manage multiple customer projects from order handover through delivery and completion, representing ABB as the central point of contact for our customers.

  • Planning and coordination: Plan and manage schedules, scope of supply, and interfaces, while coordinating collaboration with international supply factories, factory project managers, engineering, production, logistics, and local partners.

  • Commercial project management: Monitor project costs, risks, changes, and claims, identify deviations at an early stage, and implement appropriate actions in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Project close-out and continuous improvement: Take responsibility for customer acceptance, project documentation, and commercial close-out, and actively contribute your experience and lessons learned to the continuous improvement of our project execution processes.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • At least three years of experience independently managing multiple customer projects, with demonstrated end-to-end responsibility for projects of appropriate technical and organizational complexity.

  • Demonstrated professional experience with electrical installations, electrical products, or electrical system solutions. A qualification or degree in electrical engineering and experience with medium-voltage switchgear are considered an advantage.

  • Proven practical ability to manage schedules, costs, risks, changes, and interfaces in an industrial, customer-focused, and delivery-oriented environment.

  • Very good German and English skills, enabling you to independently and confidently conduct demanding customer discussions, manage escalations, and handle commercial and contractual negotiations.

  • A structured, independent, and pragmatic way of working, combined with the ability to prioritize and transparently manage multiple projects of varying sizes and to take a solution-oriented approach when deviations occur.

  • Practical knowledge of commonly used project management and collaboration tools. An entry-level project management certification or a comparable qualification is expected. Applicants with demonstrated practical project management experience and a willingness to complete the certification through our internal project management program will also be considered

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.
With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kV), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations.
We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
