At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Project Operations Manager

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle sind Sie für die erfolgreiche Durchführung von Kundenprojekten mit Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen und anderen elektrotechnischen Lösungen für den Schweizer Markt verantwortlich. Sie managen Ihre Projekte von der Auftragsübergabe über die Lieferung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss und fungieren als zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden.

Sie arbeiten eng mit den Projekt- und Ingenieurteams unserer internationalen Zulieferfabriken sowie mit lokalen Fachfunktionen zusammen. Sie verwalten ein Portfolio von Projekten unterschiedlicher Größe und stellen die Einhaltung von Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität und vertraglichen Anforderungen sicher.

Das Arbeitsmodell für diese Position lautet: Hybrid #LI-hybrid

Diese Position ist Teil des Geschäftsbereichs Electrification Distribution Solutions in der Schweiz.

Ihre Hauptverantwortung

  • End-to-End-Projektverantwortung: Verwalten mehrerer Kundenprojekte von der Auftragsübergabe bis zur Lieferung und Fertigstellung, wobei ABB als zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden fungiert.

  • Planung und Koordination: Planung und Verwaltung von Zeitplänen, Lieferumfang und Schnittstellen, während die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Zulieferfabriken, Projektmanagern, Ingenieuren, Produktion, Logistik und lokalen Partnern koordiniert wird.

  • Kommerzielles Projektmanagement: Projektkosten, Risiken, Änderungen und Ansprüche überwachen, Abweichungen frühzeitig erkennen und geeignete Maßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern umsetzen.

  • Projekt-Close-Out und kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für Kundenakzeptanz, Projektdokumentation und kommerzielle Close-Out und bringen Sie Ihre Erfahrungen und Erfahrungen aktiv zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Projektabwicklungsprozesse ein.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der unabhängigen Verwaltung mehrerer Kundenprojekte mit nachgewiesener End-to-End-Verantwortung für Projekte von angemessener technischer und organisatorischer Komplexität.

  • Demonstrierte Berufserfahrung mit elektrischen Installationen, elektrischen Produkten oder elektrischen Systemlösungen. Eine Qualifikation oder ein Abschluss in Elektrotechnik und Erfahrung mit Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen gelten als Vorteil.

  • Bewährte praktische Fähigkeit, Zeitpläne, Kosten, Risiken, Änderungen und Schnittstellen in einer industriellen, kundenorientierten und lieferungsorientierten Umgebung zu verwalten.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, unabhängig und selbstbewusst anspruchsvolle Kundengespräche zu führen, Eskalationen zu managen und kaufmännische und vertragliche Verhandlungen zu führen.

  • Eine strukturierte, unabhängige und pragmatische Arbeitsweise, kombiniert mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte unterschiedlicher Größe zu priorisieren und transparent zu managen und bei Abweichungen einen lösungsorientierten Ansatz zu verfolgen.

  • Praktische Kenntnisse der gängigen Projektmanagement- und Collaboration-Tools. Es wird eine Entry-Level Projektmanagement Zertifizierung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erwartet. Bewerber mit nachgewiesener praktischer Projektmanagement-Erfahrung und der Bereitschaft, die Zertifizierung durch unser internes Projektmanagement-Programm abzuschließen, werden ebenfalls berücksichtigt

Mehr über uns

>ABBs Division Distribution Solutions bietet Mittelspannungskomponenten, Schaltanlagen und Lösungen, die das sich entwickelnde Stromnetz verbinden und schützen und eine zuverlässige und vorhersehbare Energieverteilung gewährleisten. Wir verbinden Hochspannungssysteme mit Mittel- und Niederspannungsverbrauchern und gewährleisten eine kontinuierliche Stromversorgung für Industrie-, Gewerbe- und Privatanwender und ermöglichen gleichzeitig die Integration erneuerbarer Energiequellen in das Netz. Unsere intelligenten Lösungen, powered by AI, verbessern die Netzresistenz und optimieren die Nutzung des elektrischen Systems.
Mit ABB AbilityTM-fähigen vernetzten Lösungen umfasst das Angebot Mittelspannungs-luft- und gasisolierte Schaltanlagen (1 bis 46 kV), Innen- und Außenleistungsschalter, Schutzrelais, Messwandler, Sensoren und Lösungen für Verteilerstationen.
Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden und Partner dabei, den zunehmenden Elektrifizierungsbedarf, die Technologie und die regulatorischen Änderungen immer weiter zu steigern und bieten die Möglichkeit, sich an eine sich schnell entwickelnde Energielandschaft anzupassen.

Dans ce rôle polyvalent, vous serez responsable de l'exécution réussie de projets clients impliquant des commutateurs à moyenne tension et d'autres solutions d'ingénierie électrique pour le marché suisse.   • Expérience professionnelle démontrée avec des installations électriques, des produits électriques ou des solutions de systèmes électriques. Une qualification ou un diplôme en génie électrique et l'expérience de la commande à moyenne tension sont considérés comme un avantage.

  • Capacité pratique éprouvée de gérer les horaires, les coûts, les risques, les changements et les interfaces dans un environnement industriel, axé sur le client et axé sur la prestation.

  • De très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais, vous permettant de mener de façon indépendante et confiante des discussions avec les clients exigeants, de gérer des escalades et de gérer des négociations commerciales et contractuelles.

  • Une façon de travailler structurée, indépendante et pragmatique, combinée à la capacité de prioriser et de gérer de façon transparente plusieurs projets de différentes tailles et d'adopter une approche axée sur la solution lorsque des écarts se produisent.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager

__

Your Role

In this dynamic sales position, you will drive market development with switchgear manufacturers across the North-West region of German-speaking Switzerland. You will identify market opportunities, build strong customer relationships, and successfully position our electrical power distribution solutions. Working collaboratively with internal teams, channel partners, and stakeholders, you'll contribute directly to sustainable business growth.

Work Model: Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden, Kanton Aargau.

Your • Responsibilities

  • Achieve sales targets by identifying new market opportunities, building a sustainable sales pipeline in Salesforce, and developing targeted business strategies

  • Guide customer projects from opportunity to completion, creating tailored technical and commercial solutions with internal teams and partners

  • Cultivate long-term partnerships by identifying customer needs, providing expert consulting, and delivering excellent service throughout the sales cycle

  • Coordinate all stakeholders and manage professional sales processes, ensuring accurate communication on delivery times, terms, and contractual conditions

• Qualifications

  • Several years of successful experience in technical or project sales, ideally in switchgear, power distribution, or building technology with proven track record

  • Technical background with relevant training or studies in electrical engineering and power distribution

  • Ability to navigate complex sales processes and communicate effectively with decision-makers at all levels

  • Demonstrated strength in building sustainable client relationships with a partnership-focused approach

  • Strategic consulting expertise on business models, market positioning, and differentiation

  • Structured, solution-oriented approach with strong prioritization and adaptability in dynamic environments

  • Collaborative team player with professional communication skills and cross-departmental mindset

  • Language skills: Native German speaker, any additional language is a plus

  • Valid Category B driving license and a valid Swiss work permit

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credit

  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Fitness allowance

  • Company Car

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings optimizes energy efficiency, safety, security, and comfort across all building types through innovative digital technologies and integrated solutions. We serve diverse markets—from single-family homes to industrial applications—with scalable solutions that deliver sustainable and financial benefits while supporting carbon reduction strategies.

This recruiting process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop service sales, from lead generation, service sales opportunities creation until securing the profitable sales within the designated areas. Each day, you will focus on Installed Base (IB) and sell the entire Service portfolio. You will also showcase your skills by building long-term customer relationships and ensuring immediate response to specific customer needs and issues.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

This role contributes to the Service of Mining and Materials Business Line within the Automation Process Industries division in a defined global region.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Penetrating into IB, promoting various upgrades, retrofits, and value-add services to the benefit of the customers and ABB.
  • Understanding the channel strategy and the establishment of related prices, preparing sales plans, reviewing them, and proposing recovery plan(s) when needed.
  • Generating service sales leads and developing new market opportunities by utilizing market trend information and through identifying and exploring potential new service portfolios.
  • Acting as a marketer/salesperson of ABB’s service products and solutions during marketing activities (campaigns, trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings).


Our team dynamics
You will join an international collaborative team working in a changing business environment, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Engineering Disciplines, Business Administration or similar and 5+ years of experience in the mining business. Experience in service sales or similar roles is very beneficial
  • You are highly motivated and enjoy working in agile market and you’re willing to travel up to 30% worldwide
  • Demonstrated experience in managing global accounts, increasing sales growth, and complex negotiations
  • Solid stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams and customers
  • Solid data-driven pipeline & forecasting discipline (e.g., SFDC)
  • Experience with digital sales enablement, customer demonstrations, and lifecycle-service offerings are advantages.
  • Proven tender/pursuit leadership up to complex, high-value solution deals
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English and German

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Learning and growth opportunities
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Generous vacation allowance


More about us
We help the mining industry become safer, leaner, and more sustainable by combining electrification, automation, and digital technologies with over 130 years of experience.
Our comprehensive mining services portfolio - ranging from engineering and maintenance to digital and lifecycle solutions - supports customers in maximizing asset performance and availability.
Together with our customers, we deliver tailored, data-driven solutions that enable reliable operations today while shaping the future of the all-electric, connected mine.

The recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

__

As Sales Manager - Panel Builders, you will lead one of ABB Electrification's key sales channels in Switzerland. Combining strategic leadership with a strong customer focus, you will drive profitable growth, strengthen long-term customer relationships, and lead a high-performing sales team. Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will play an important role in shaping our commercial success while helping customers accelerate the transition to a more sustainable and electrified future.

The working model is: LI-Hybrid

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Lead, coach, and develop the local Panel Builders sales team, fostering a high-performance, customer-centric culture and ensuring strong market coverage across all regions of Switzerland.

  • Drive profitable growth by identifying new business opportunities and implementing effective sales, market segmentation, and pricing strategies aligned with ABB’s business objectives.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and partners, ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the entire sales process.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product marketing, operations, and other stakeholders to support business success, while coordinating sales information flow, providing accurate forecasts and market insights, and managing commercial and contractual risks.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree or similar in a technical field (preferably Electrical Engineering) with minimum 3 years of successful sales leadership background with a proven track record in the Swiss market.

  • Demonstrated people leadership experience and solid cross-functional collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across functions and organizational levels.

  • Good technical knowledge of energy distribution and low-voltage switchgear or similar technical field. Furthermore, ability and interest to sell and promote digital solutions.

  • Sound understanding of contract negotiations, risk management, and commercial and legal terms.

  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a professional, proactive "can-do" attitude.

  • Fluent in German, with a good command of French and English.

More about us:

Electrification offers technologies across the entire electrification value chain—from the substation to the point of consumption. In doing so, it contributes to a secure and reliable power supply. The portfolio includes digital and connected innovations that improve the reliability and efficiency of low- and medium-voltage electrical installations. These include electric vehicle charging infrastructure, modular substations, distribution automation solutions, switchgear, sensor technology and control systems, as well as KNX systems for the automation and networking of building infrastructure.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

As an R&D Senior Engineer, you will leverage your technical expertise to validate and customize OEM single-phase and three-phase low-voltage Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), ensuring they meet the requirements of mission-critical power protection applications and market specifications.

Reporting to R&D Hardware Chapter Lead, based in Quartino Switzerland, you will contribute significantly to initiatives related to ABB’s Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS) products

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Location: Quartino Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead technical validation and customization of OEM 1ph and 3ph low voltage Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS), as well as batteries and accessories.
  • Manage test partners (UL, Intertek, Dekra, Eurofins, etc.) to scope and plan test programs to demonstrate compliance with applicable IEC or UL standards.
  • Manage the technical specifications of assigned products and support the Product Manager in developing the business case for product development.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions related to issues found during qualification testing, as well as issues identified at customer sites.
  • Maintain awareness of state-of-the-art technologies and collaborate with the research center in Switzerland and other ABB stakeholders to identify potential new UPS technologies.

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, along with more than five years of professional experience in electrical engineering.
  • Must have experience working with power electronic systems
  • Experience in the use of various measuring equipment in a laboratory environment.
  • Knowledge of product regulations and standards, including IEC and UL.
  • Experience working with external laboratories and certification bodies.
  • Knowledge of ECNs (Engineering Change Notifications), BOMs (Bills of Materials), and documentation systems.
  • Experience with failure investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Knowledge of and experience with Agile methodology is an advantage.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Unit Lead

__

At ABB’s Research Center in Baden-Dättwil, Switzerland, we explore new technologies that support and drive the development of ABB’s next-generation products and solutions.


The Industrial Solutions department is organized into four research teams that collaborate closely with development teams across ABB’s various divisions. Our research activities cover a broad range of fields, including Power Electronics (converter topologies, control, EMC, and reliability), Industrial Software (cybersecurity, ML/AI, real-time embedded systems, and connected systems), as well as Sensing & Analytics (sensor technologies, perception, and electronics).


This is a unique opportunity for a leader who is passionate about combining people management with the strategic alignment of an R&D department, while also overseeing operational aspects such as work safety, R&D processes, and stakeholder management.

Your main responsibilities include

  • Lead and represent the department with 45 members: people management (recruitment, development), support of project portfolio management and research strategy, continuous improvement of processes and lab infrastructure

  • Support the Research Center Management Team as active member, including the coordination of global R&D activities

  • Guarantee professional, top quality definition and execution of R&D projects

  • Contribute to extend the technical and process knowledge to the organization with special focus on HSE topics

• Qualifications for the role

  • Experience in leading an R&D group or an R&D department

  • Communication and leadership skills

  • PhD in physics, electrical engineering, computer science, chemistry or a similar R&D track record

  • Knowledge of at least two of the core topics described above, combined with a willingness and ability to develop knowledge in other areas

  • Experience with the development process for industrial products

  • Track record in delivering market-oriented R&D results

  • Fluency in English and basic knowledge of German


More about us
• We offer an inspiring international environment, the opportunity to influence breakthrough technologies with real-world impact, and excellent prospects for professional and leadership development.

The hiring process for this role is managed by Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Implements the sales strategy and drives the respective sales process in Hydropower and industries in collaboration with the Local Division Sales Manager and the Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Generates sales opportunities and secures profitable sales for ABB’s Energy Industries Division and its Business Line Power Reliability in Switzerland.   • Focuses on new greenfield projects, as well as on Installed Base (IB) and brownfield penetration and sells the entire solutions portfolio (across automation, excitation, protection, electrification, grid code compliance studies, and digital solutions) in collaboration with other ABB units.

  • Sells entire solutions portfolio to expand ABB’s footprint in Switzerland and acts as a marketer/salesperson of ABB’s products and solutions during marketing activities (campaigns, trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings).

  • Strong solution selling and value proposition creation abilities, cybersecurity and digital solutions acumen.

  • Strong understanding of project dynamics and Installed Base (IB) concepts and confidently promoting value‑adding solutions.

  • Skilled in identifying, developing, and securing sales opportunities based on customer needs and market trends.

  • Customer-focused mindset with strong communication and negotiation skills, building long‑term customer relationships and responding quickly and professionally to customer issues.

Setzt die Vertriebsstrategie um und steuert den entsprechenden Verkaufsprozess im Bereich Wasserkraft und Industrie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem lokalen Divisionsvertriebsleiter sowie dem Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Baut langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und gewährleistet eine schnelle und professionelle Reaktion auf spezifische Kundenanforderungen und Anliegen.

Qualifikationen

  • Erfahrung in Business Development, technischem Vertrieb oder im Angebots- und Ausschreibungsmanagement, idealerweise in den Bereichen Energieerzeugung, Automatisierung, Elektrifizierung oder Industrie.

Met en œuvre la stratégie commerciale et pilote le processus de vente correspondant dans les secteurs de l’hydroélectricité et de l’industrie, en collaboration avec le Responsable commercial local de la division et le Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Génère des opportunités commerciales et assure des ventes rentables pour la division Energy Industries d’ABB et sa Business Line Power Reliability en Suisse. Développe des relations clients durables et garantit une réponse rapide aux besoins et problématiques spécifiques des clients.

Responsabilités principales

  • Se concentre sur les nouveaux projets Greenfield ainsi que sur le développement de la base installée (Installed Base, IB) et des projets Brownfield.   • Comprend la stratégie de vente indirecte et la politique tarifaire associée. Prépare les plans de vente, les analyse et propose des plans d’actions correctifs lorsque cela est nécessaire.

• Qualifications requises

  • Expérience en développement commercial, vente technique ou gestion des offres et appels d’offres, idéalement dans les secteurs de la production d’énergie, de l’automatisation, de l’électrification ou de l’industrie.

  • Forte orientation client, excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation, avec une capacité à construire des relations durables et à répondre rapidement et professionnellement aux demandes des clients.

  • Disponibilité pour des déplacements professionnels pouvant atteindre 50 % du temps.

  • Maîtrise courante de l’allemand et de l’anglais ; la connaissance d’autres langues, notamment le français, constitue un atout.

More about us

ABB’s Energy Industries Division is enabling safe, smart, and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation, and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize, and electrify operations across industries. The division strives to connect our people and technology capabilities, along with our robust global execution capacity and widespread service footprint to help customers adapt and succeed. With over 50 years of domain expertise, we continue to innovate and reshape traditional approaches across the energy sector with our technologies, that are designed to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, decrease energy consumption and waste.

Our Benefits

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th-month salary, and participation programs (ESAP).

  • Career development through targeted training and development opportunities.

  • REKA checks for leisure and travel.

  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year.

  • Various discounts on sports equipment, electronics, and health & wellness offers.

  • Contribution toward gym membership.

The recruitment process is led by Talent Partner Gema de Vicente.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Contributes to ABB's success with technology, software, product, and/or system development. Identifies and implements innovative solutions to relevant problems. Provides ideas and can work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, products, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Location: Quartino Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Firmware Development: Design, develop, and implement firmware for Power Electronic Converters and communication modules, ensuring robust functionality and cybersecurity
  • Software Quality Assurance: Conduct unit, integration, and system testing to validate software performance and reliability
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with system architects and hardware/software engineers to translate system requirements into detailed firmware specifications
  • Innovation and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to intellectual property creation and collaborate with global engineering teams to drive continuous improvement and share expertise

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • M.Sc. or B.Sc. degree in Information or Electrical, Power Electronic, Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems, or comparable field
  • You have at least 3 years of experience in designing control firmware based on microcontrollers / DSPs for Power Electronic Products such as UPS, BESS, Renewable Energy systems
  • You are highly skilled in C/C++/Python and Firmware Development.
  • You have solid knowledge in structured development processes, ranging from requirement analysis, design, and implementation to test and documentation.
  • Experience with development infrastructure, including Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (Git), lifecycle management, build systems, unit testing, debug probes, oscilloscopes, and similar tools
  • Exposure to Cyber Security concepts and knowledge of main industrial communication protocols (Modbus, CAN, EtherCAT) are a plus
  • You are passionate about teamwork and innovation.
  • You are at ease communicating in English and Italian

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.


Run What Runs the World.

#ABBCareers #RunwithABB

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Chapter Lead

As an R&D Engineer, you will leverage your technical expertise to validate and customize OEM single-phase and three-phase low-voltage Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), ensuring they meet the requirements of mission-critical power protection applications and market specifications.

Reporting to R&D Hardware Chapter Lead, based in Quartino Switzerland, you will contribute significantly to initiatives related to ABB’s Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS) products

jobs.title: Global Category Specialist Power Components
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Procurement Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

The Global Procurement Specialist / Global Category Specialist for Power Electronics Components is a senior individual contributor responsible for developing and executing global category strategies for key power semiconductor and passive components used across ABB's power electronics product lines. The role requires deep technical knowledge of power electronics BOMs, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to manage complex, multi-site supplier relationships globally.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

Your main accountabilities will be to:
  • Define and execute global category sourcing strategies for IGBTs, Film/Electrolytic Capacitors, SCRs, Thyristors, Displays, and Fuses.
  • Lead global RFQ/RFP processes; conduct TCO analysis, cost benchmarking, and commercial negotiations with tier-1 and strategic semiconductor suppliers.
  • Develop and maintain long-term agreements (LTAs) and global frame contracts with key suppliers (e.g. Infineon, ABB Semiconductors, Vishay, KYOCERA, Eaton, Littelfuse, etc.).
  • Manage supplier qualification and onboarding in collaboration with Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) and R&D teams.
  • Analyse global spend, supplier concentration, and market trends; develop dual-source and multi-source strategies to mitigate supply risk.
  • Monitor power semiconductor market dynamics (silicon, SiC, GaN), component lifecycle, and obsolescence management; implement last-time-buy strategies.
  • Drive year-over-year cost savings through volume consolidation, competitive sourcing, design-to-cost, and VA/VE initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and NPI teams globally to influence component selection and ensure strategic alignment from product concept through mass production.
  • Manage end-to-end contract lifecycle: drafting, review, execution, and compliance monitoring.
  • Report category performance (cost savings, OTD, quality, risk) to senior management on a regular basis.
  • Support global sites (Bangalore, Quartino, Richmond, Frosinone, and others) in executing local procurement aligned with global category strategy.
  • Ensure full compliance with ABB procurement policies, trade-compliance requirements (export control, sanctions), and supplier sustainability (ESG) standards.


Key Performance Indicators

  • Annual cost savings vs. target (PPV, negotiated savings)
  • Supplier On-Time Delivery (OTD) and quality performance
  • LTA / frame contract coverage (% of category spend)
  • Single-source risk reduction (dual-source coverage rate)
  • Component obsolescence incidents and resolution time
  • Supplier sustainability (ESG) assessment coverage

Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic team, where you will be able to thrive.



• Qualifications for the role
  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics/Power Electronics Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
  • 5–12 years of experience in strategic procurement or category management for power electronics or semiconductor components.
  • Deep technical understanding of IGBTs, thyristors, SCRs, capacitors, fuses, and display technologies used in industrial power electronics.
  • Proven track record in global supplier negotiations, LTA management, and category strategy execution.
  • Familiarity with power electronics products (drives, converters, UPS, traction, renewable energy systems) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, or similar sourcing platforms; advanced MS Excel and Power BI skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally (up to 20–30%).
  • Fluent English (mandatory); Italian, German, or Spanish is an advantage depending on location.
  • Professional certifications (CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent) are a plus.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Manage end-to-end contract lifecycle: drafting, review, execution, and compliance monitoring.
  • Report category performance (cost savings, OTD, quality, risk) to senior management on a regular basis.
  • Support global sites (Bangalore, Quartino, Richmond, Frosinone, and others) in executing local procurement aligned with global category strategy.
  • Ensure full compliance with ABB procurement policies, trade-compliance requirements (export control, sanctions), and supplier sustainability (ESG) standards.


Key Performance Indicators

  • Annual cost savings vs. target (PPV, negotiated savings)
  • Supplier On-Time Delivery (OTD) and quality performance
  • LTA / frame contract coverage (% of category spend)
  • Single-source risk reduction (dual-source coverage rate)
  • Component obsolescence incidents and resolution time
  • Supplier sustainability (ESG) assessment coverage

Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic team, where you will be able to thrive.



• Qualifications for the role
  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics/Power Electronics Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
  • 5–12 years of experience in strategic procurement or category management for power electronics or semiconductor components.
  • Deep technical understanding of IGBTs, thyristors, SCRs, capacitors, fuses, and display technologies used in industrial power electronics.
  • Proven track record in global supplier negotiations, LTA management, and category strategy execution.
  • Familiarity with power electronics products (drives, converters, UPS, traction, renewable energy systems) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, or similar sourcing platforms; advanced MS Excel and Power BI skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally (up to 20–30%).
  • Fluent English (mandatory); Italian, German, or Spanish is an advantage depending on location.
  • Professional certifications (CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent) are a plus.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus rationnelle et plus propre. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez-nous à exécuter ce qui fonctionne dans le monde.

Ce poste relève de:

Global Procurement Manager

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Le Global Procurement Specialist / Global Category Specialist for Power Electronics Components est un collaborateur principal chargé d'élaborer et d'exécuter des stratégies de catégorie mondiale pour les principaux semi-conducteurs de puissance et composants passifs utilisés dans les gammes de produits de l'électronique de puissance d'ABB. Le rôle exige une connaissance technique approfondie de l'électronique de puissance BOMs, une forte acuité commerciale et la capacité de gérer des relations complexes et multi-sites avec les fournisseurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :
  • Définir et exécuter des stratégies d'approvisionnement de catégorie mondiale pour les IGBT, les condensateurs de films/électrolytiques, les SCR, les thyristors, les affichages et les Fuses.
  • Diriger les processus mondiaux de QRF/FPR; effectuer des analyses de TCO, des analyses comparatives des coûts et des négociations commerciales avec les fournisseurs de semi-conducteurs stratégiques de niveau 1.
  • Élaborer et maintenir des ententes à long terme (ALE) et des contrats-cadres mondiaux avec des fournisseurs clés (p. ex. Infineon, ABB Semiconductors, Vishay, KYOCERA, Eaton, Littelfuse, etc.).
  • Gérer la qualification et l'embarquement des fournisseurs en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de la qualité des fournisseurs et de R-D.
  • Analyser les dépenses mondiales, la concentration des fournisseurs et les tendances du marché; élaborer des stratégies à double source et à plusieurs sources pour atténuer le risque d'approvisionnement.
  • Moniteur dynamique du marché des semi-conducteurs d'énergie (silicon, SiC, GaN), cycle de vie des composants et gestion de l'obsolescence; mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'achat de dernière fois.
  • Conduire des économies de coûts d'une année à l'autre grâce à la consolidation du volume, à l'approvisionnement concurrentiel, à la conception au coût et aux initiatives d'AV/VE.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes du génie et de l'INN à l'échelle mondiale pour influer sur la sélection des composantes et assurer l'alignement stratégique du concept de produit à la production de masse.
  • Gérer le cycle de vie des contrats de bout en bout : rédaction, examen, exécution et surveillance de la conformité.
  • Rapporter régulièrement le rendement de la catégorie (économies de coûts, DTO, qualité, risque) à la haute direction.
  • Soutenir les sites mondiaux (Bangalore, Quartino, Richmond, Frosinone, etc.) dans l'exécution des achats locaux conformément à la stratégie de catégorie mondiale.
  • Assurer la pleine conformité aux politiques d'approvisionnement de l'ABB, aux exigences en matière de conformité au commerce (contrôle des exportations, sanctions) et aux normes de durabilité des fournisseurs (ESG).


Indicateurs clés de rendement

  • Épargne annuelle des coûts par rapport à la cible (PPV, économies négociées)
  • Livraison en temps utile du fournisseur (OTD) et rendement de qualité
  • Couverture du contrat par l'ALT/cadre (% des dépenses de catégorie)
  • Réduction des risques à source unique (taux de couverture à double source)
  • Incidences d'obsolescence du composant et délai de résolution
  • Couverture de l'évaluation de la viabilité du fournisseur (ESG)

Notre dynamique d'équipe
Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique où vous pourrez prospérer.



• Qualifications pour le rôle
  • Bachelor's/Master en génie électrique/électronique/électronique de puissance, en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • 5–12 ans d'expérience en approvisionnement stratégique ou en gestion de catégorie pour l'électronique de puissance ou les composants semi-conducteurs.
  • Compréhension technique approfondie des technologies IGBT, thyristors, SCR, condensateurs, fusibles et techniques d'affichage utilisées dans l'électronique de puissance industrielle.
  • Expérience éprouvée dans les négociations mondiales sur les fournisseurs, la gestion de l'ALT et l'exécution de la stratégie de catégorie.
  • La familiarité avec les produits électroniques de puissance (drives, convertisseurs, UPS, traction, systèmes d'énergie renouvelable) est fortement préférée.
  • Expérience avec SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, ou des plateformes d'approvisionnement similaires; compétences avancées MS Excel et Power BI.
  • Capacité et volonté de voyager à l'étranger (jusqu'à 20-30%).
  • Fluent English (obligatoire); italien, allemand ou espagnol est un avantage selon l'emplacement.
  • Les certifications professionnelles (CPSM, CIPS ou équivalent) sont un plus.

Cette possibilité est ouverte aux candidats dans plusieurs pays, le lieu de travail final étant déterminé en fonction du candidat sélectionné. Comme la rémunération peut varier selon le lieu, nous nous engageons à être transparents tout au long du processus d'embauche et partagerons les détails de l'échelle salariale, de la rémunération variable et des avantages sociaux avec les candidats qui passent à la première étape d'entrevue pour un lieu dans l'Union européenne, couverte par la directive de l'UE sur la transparence des rémunérations.
L'offre finale sera adaptée en fonction de votre emplacement, expérience, compétences et qualifications, positionnement du marché intérieur et alignement sur les normes internes ABB.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Field Service Engineer


Your role and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will execute service work on rolling stock and energy storing systems with low to medium complexity according to work instructions and in accordance with ABB standard processes, quality standards and safety guidelines. You will be in close cooperation with customers and other ABB teams, acting as the technical point while delivering quality and satisfying customer service.

Reporting to the Head of Field Service, you will be responsible for providing routine maintenance and on-site or remote technical support. The position involves approximately 50 days of domestic and 30 days of international travel, as you will be providing hands-on assistance at customer sites.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Performing service tasks like installation and commissioning of equipment, identifying technical problems, making analysis through remote or on-site activity in different service categories (installation and commissioning, routine maintenance, extensions, replacements etc.)
  • Consulting with and advising customers on the best service solutions in accordance with standard processes, procedures, and safety guidelines. Furthermore creating and maintaining strong relationships with customers, appreciating their needs, and providing specialist assistance and solutions
  • Coordinating and executing specialist projects through planning, meeting milestones and regular reviews
  • Troubleshooting simple equipment failure and making recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future. Identifying opportunities to develop new service applications, equipment and methods

• Qualifications for the role

  • Four years of experience in electrical work, testing, maintenance, or service, working as test- or commissioning engineer with power electronics or on electrical vehicles
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience in servicing, maintaining, commissioning and repairing of power electronic products
  • Ability to travel worldwide
  • Proven leadership skills, with a collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills
  • A technician or engineer bachelor’s degree in electrotechnics
  • Required language skills are fluent German, French, and English

More about us

ABB Traction Division is a recognized leader in onboard propulsion technologies that drive innovation in rail, bus, and industrial vehicle electrification. A comprehensive range of high-performance and full lifecycle managed propulsion, auxiliary and energy storage solutions help improve energy efficiency and contribute to making transportation more sustainable. We all together make the difference for our customers every day. We look forward to receiving your application.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com. ABB Data Privacy Statement: https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/candidate

- Consulenza e consulenza dei clienti sulle migliori soluzioni di servizio in conformità con i processi, le procedure e le linee guida di sicurezza standard. Inoltre c ritaking e mantenere rapporti forti con i clienti, apprezzando le loro esigenze, e fornendo assistenza e soluzioni specialistiche

- Risoluzione dei problemi relativi alla semplice mancanza di attrezzature e raccomandazioni per evitare di ripetere il problema in futuro.

- K nowledge ed esperienza pratica nella manutenzione, manutenzione, messa in servizio e riparazione di prodotti elettronici di alimentazione

- Capacità di viaggiare in tutto il mondo

- Competenze di leadership di Proven, con un approccio collaborativo e risolutivo e forte capacità comunicative scritte e parlate

- Laurea in elettrotecnica in ingegneria o ingegneria

- Le competenze linguistiche richieste sono fluenti in tedesco, francese e inglese

Più su di noi

ABB Traction Division è un leader riconosciuto nelle tecnologie di propulsione a bordo che guidano l'innovazione nell'elettrificazione di veicoli ferroviari, autobus e industriali. Una gamma completa di propulsione ad alte prestazioni e a ciclo di vita gestito, soluzioni ausiliarie e di stoccaggio dell'energia contribuiscono a migliorare l'efficienza energetica e contribuiscono a rendere i trasporti più sostenibili. Tutti insieme facciamo la differenza per i nostri clienti ogni giorno.

- Vier Jahre Erfahrung in der elektrischen Arbeit, Prüfung, Wartung oder Service, als Prüf- oder Inbetriebnahmeingenieur mit Leistungselektronik oder auf Elektrofahrzeugen

- K nowledge und praktische Erfahrung in der Wartung, Wartung, Inbetriebnahme und Reparatur von power electronic Produkten

- Techniker oder Ingenieur Bachelor, s Abschluss in Elektrotechnik

Mehr über uns

ABB Traction Division ist ein anerkannter Marktführer in der Antriebstechnik von Onboard, die Innovationen in der Elektrifizierung von Schienen-, Bus- und Industriefahrzeugen vorantreibt. Eine umfassende Palette an Hochleistungs- und Lebenszyklus-gesteuerten Antriebs-, Hilfs- und Energiespeicherlösungen trägt zur Steigerung der Energieeffizienz und zur nachhaltigen Gestaltung des Verkehrs bei. Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à dépasser - plus maigre et plus propre. Ici, le progrès est une attente - pour vous, votre équipe, et le monde. En tant que leader mondial du marché, nous vous donnerons ce que vous avez besoin pour que cela arrive. Cela ne sera pas toujours facile, la croissance prend du grain.

Ce poste relève de : Ingénieur du Service mobile

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

En tant qu'ingénieur de service, vous exécuterez des travaux de service sur le matériel roulant et les systèmes de stockage d'énergie avec une complexité faible à moyenne selon les instructions de travail et conformément aux processus standards ABB, aux normes de qualité et aux lignes directrices de sécurité.

Sous la responsabilité du chef du Service mobile, vous serez chargé de fournir un service d'entretien régulier et un soutien technique sur place ou à distance. Le poste comprend environ 50 jours de voyage intérieur et 30 jours de voyage international, car vous fournirez une assistance pratique sur les sites clients.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est: #LI-Hybrid

Les principales responsabilités sont notamment les suivantes:

- Effectuer des tâches de service telles que l'installation et la mise en service de l'équipement, identifier les problèmes techniques, effectuer des analyses par des activités à distance ou sur place dans différentes catégories de services (installation et mise en service, entretien de routine, extensions, remplacements, etc.)

- Conseils et conseils aux clients sur les meilleures solutions de service conformément aux procédures, procédures et directives de sécurité standard.

- Coordination et exécution de projets spécialisés par la planification, la réalisation des étapes et des examens réguliers

- en tenant compte de la défaillance de l'équipement et en formulant des recommandations pour éviter de répéter le problème à l'avenir.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

- Quatre ans d'expérience dans le travail, l'essai, la maintenance ou la maintenance électrique, travaillant comme ingénieur d'essai ou de mise en service avec électronique de puissance ou sur des véhicules électriques

- Expérience pratique et pratique dans l'entretien, la maintenance, la mise en service et la réparation de produits électroniques de puissance

- Capacité de voyager dans le monde entier

- Provenez des compétences en leadership, avec une approche collaborative et axée sur la solution et des compétences solides en communication écrite et orale

- Baccalauréat en électrotechnique, technicien ou ingénieur

- Les compétences linguistiques requises sont couramment l'allemand, le français et l'anglais

Plus sur nous

ABB Traction Division est un leader reconnu dans les technologies de propulsion embarquées qui stimulent l'innovation dans l'électrification des véhicules ferroviaires, bus et industriels. Une gamme complète de solutions de propulsion, auxiliaires et de stockage d'énergie gérées par cycle de vie complet et performants contribuent à améliorer l'efficacité énergétique et contribuent à rendre le transport plus durable.

Si vous voulez en savoir plus sur ABB, consultez notre site Web www.abb.com. Déclaration de confidentialité des données ABB : https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/cadidate

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Field Service Engineer, you are a key player in our organization and one of our primary ambassadors to our customers. The value of our solutions is also reflected in the quality of their implementation in the field. Whether it involves commissioning, maintenance, or troubleshooting, our specialists are recognized and valued for their technical expertise, professionalism, and interpersonal skills.

The work model for the role is field-based.


This role is contributing to the Motion Service, Local Sales Unit in Morges.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Installation, commissioning, maintenance, and repair of frequency converters (drives).

  • Fault diagnosis and troubleshooting directly at customer sites.

  • Administrative tasks such as service reports, protocols and technical reports, as well as on-call duty.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Federal Certificate of Proficiency (CFC) in Automation, Automation Assembly, Electronics, Electrical Installation, Electrical Assembly, or equivalent qualification.

  • Advanced Federal Diploma (ES) or University of Applied Sciences degree (HES) is a plus.

  • Experience in the field of power electronics is desired.

  • Excellent command of French; good communication skills in English are required. Knowledge of German is an advantage.

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools.

  • Availability for a field-based role with frequent travel across Switzerland and on-call duty.

  • Good communication skills.

  • Self-reliant, responsible, and customer-oriented personality.

Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credit

  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Fitness allowance

  • Eco bonus

  • Company Car

More about us

ABB Motion provides pioneering technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators and drives for a wide range of applications in all industrial sectors.

This recruitment process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen, Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Service Operations Manager

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire des opérations de service

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

En tant qu'ingénieur en service mobile, vous êtes un acteur clé de notre organisation et l'un de nos ambassadeurs principaux auprès de nos clients. La valeur de nos solutions se reflète également dans la qualité de leur mise en œuvre sur le terrain. Qu'il s'agisse de mise en service, de maintenance ou de dépannage, nos spécialistes sont reconnus et valorisés pour leur expertise technique, leur professionnalisme et leurs compétences interpersonnelles.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est basé sur le terrain.


Ce rôle contribue au Service des mouvements, Unité des ventes locales à Morges.

Vous serez principalement responsable de

  • Installation, mise en service, entretien et réparation de convertisseurs de fréquence (drives).

  • Diagnostic de faute et dépannage directement aux sites clients.

  • Tâches administratives telles que les rapports de service, les protocoles et les rapports techniques, ainsi que le service de garde.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Certificat fédéral de compétence (CFC) en automatisation, assemblage d'automatisation, électronique, installation électrique, assemblage électrique ou qualification équivalente.

  • Le diplôme fédéral avancé (ES) ou le diplôme de l'Université des sciences appliquées (HES) est un plus.

  • Une expérience dans le domaine de l'électronique de puissance est souhaitée.

  • La connaissance de l'allemand est un avantage.

  • Bonne connaissance des outils de Microsoft Office.

  • Possibilité de jouer un rôle sur le terrain avec des déplacements fréquents en Suisse et en service de garde.

  • Bénéficiaires

    Nous offrons également à nos employés les avantages suivants :

    ABB Motion fournit aux clients industriels des technologies, des produits, des solutions et des services novateurs pour accroître l'efficacité énergétique, améliorer la sécurité et la fiabilité et maintenir un contrôle précis des processus. Le portefeuille comprend des moteurs, des générateurs et des moteurs pour un large éventail d'applications dans tous les secteurs industriels.
